meaning: adj. 可靠的，可信的
example: Mr Robertson would be a credible candidate.
translation: 罗伯逊先生将是可能当选的候选人之一。

meaning: n. 对手；反对者；敌手; adj. 对立的；敌对的
example: Young and old saw in him an implacable opponent of apartheid.
translation: 无论老少都看出他是种族隔离制度的坚决反对者。

meaning: n. [数] 菱形；[数] 斜方形
example: There is a small network of rhombus in Tokyo Astronomical Observatory.
translation: 在东京天文台有一个小的菱形台网.

meaning: n. 下属，部下；走卒
example: He scrawled his name across the bill, underlining it with a showy flourish.
translation: 他在账单上潦草地签上自己的名字，并在名字下面画了一条花体线。

meaning: adj. 可理解的；明了的；仅能用智力了解的
example: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
translation: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

meaning: n. 抢夺；战利品；掠夺品; v. 掠夺；抢劫；侵吞
example: Plunder is the very nature of imperialism.
translation: 帝国主义的本性就是掠夺.

meaning: n. 独裁者，专制君主；独断独行的人
example: Murphy's powerfully spoken Oedipus is an autocrat of iconic grandeur.
translation: 墨菲激情演绎的俄狄浦斯王是位圣像般威严的独裁者。

meaning: adj. 活泼的；快活的；有生气的
adj. 缄默的；不言而喻的；心照不宣的；默许的
example: tacit knowledge
translation: 隐性知识；默会知识

meaning: n. [语] 象形文字；古代石壁画；统计图表
example: This paper is of and perfecting the book Naxi Pictograph Character Chart.
translation: 《纳西象形文字谱》是由方国瑜编撰的一部重要的东巴文字典.

meaning: adj. 紧张的；拉紧的; v. 变得紧张；使拉紧; n. 时态
example: The word tensegrity is a contraction of tensile and integrity , firstly conceived by Fuller.
translation: Tensegrity一词是tensile和integrity两词的缩写, 首先由美国人Fuller提出.

meaning: n. 突出；显著；突出物；卓越
example: Crime prevention had to be given more prominence.
translation: 防止犯罪方面应当受到更多的重视。

meaning: n. 龙虾
example: Cut the lobster shells into small pieces with heavy-duty scissors.
translation: 用粗剪将龙虾壳剪成小片。

meaning: adj. 小数的；十进位的; n. 小数
example: In 1971, the 1p and 2p decimal coins were introduced in Britain.
translation: 英国于1971年开始使用十进制的1便士和2便士硬币。

meaning: n. 意外发现珍奇事物的本领；有意外发现珍宝的运气
v. 超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解
example: Social research nowadays has a practical urgency surpassing even that of cancer research.
translation: 当今社会研究的现实迫切性甚至超过对癌症的研究.

meaning: n. 节略，缩写；减少
example: An abridgement of the book has been published for young readers.
translation: 他们为年轻读者出版了这本书的节本.

meaning: n. 混乱，骚乱；精神病院，疯人院
example: The crowd went absolutely mad. It was bedlam.
translation: 人们彻底疯了。乱成了一团。

meaning: n. 耻辱，不名誉；责骂，咒骂
example: His political opinions have attracted the opprobrium of the Left.
translation: 他的政治观点遭到左派的抨击。

meaning: adj. 基本的，根本的; n. 基本原理；基本原则
example: Amnesty says there are fundamental flaws in their military justice system.
translation: 国际特赦组织称他们的军事司法体系存在着根本性的缺陷。

meaning: adj. 无情的；不屈不挠的；不可阻挡的；无法改变的
example: His own career continues its inexorable ascent.
translation: 他事业的上升势头锐不可当。

meaning: n. [军] 机动；演习；策略；调遣; v. [军] 机动；演习；调遣；用计谋
example: She tried to maneuver her body into a more comfortable position.
translation: 她试着把身子挪了挪，换了一个较为舒服的姿势。

meaning: n. 专业，专长；特产；特性；招牌菜; adj. 特色的；专门的；独立的
example: specialty chemicals
translation: [化]专用化学品

meaning: adj. 全部的；完全的；整个的; v. 总数达; n. 总数，合计
example: in total
translation: 总计

meaning: adj. 多汁的；多水分的；多汁性的; n. 肉质植物；多汁植物
adj. 张开著；张口惊视的; adv. 目瞪口呆; n. (Agape)人名；(罗)阿加佩
example: The wind set the door agape.
translation: 风把门吹开.

meaning: v. 煽动，教唆；支持; n. (Abet)人名；(意)阿贝特；(匈)奥拜特
example: We shall strike hard, without flinching, at terrorists and those who abet them.
translation: 我们要毫不退缩地严厉打击恐怖分子及其帮凶。

meaning: n. 火盆；铜匠（等于 brasier）
example: If Brazier effect occurs on a stalk, it will bend after 25 % to 30 % of flexion.
translation: 发生Brazier屈曲的茎在危险截面的屈曲程度为25%～30%时达到临界弯距,此后进入屈曲.

meaning: n. <旧>兄弟们，同胞；〈旧〉同党，会友
example: Sri Lankans share a common ancestry with their Indian brethren.
translation: 斯里兰卡人和他们的印度兄弟有共同的祖先。

meaning: v. 使免罪
example: Alas, though, exonerate Holmes as we cannot make a great writer out of him.
translation: 然而, 可惜得很, 我们既然无法使霍姆斯成为一个伟大作家就饶了他吧.

meaning: n. 小公牛；阉牛
example: He was sweating like a bullock.
translation: 他正在辛苦地干活.

meaning: adj. 强制的；绝对的；断然的；专横的
example: The letter was peremptory in tone.
translation: 信中的语气强硬。

meaning: adj. 丰富的；丰饶的
example: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
translation: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食,把粮食积存在各城里.各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里.

meaning: n. 伪君子；伪善者
example: "Hypocrite," he sneered.
translation: “伪君子，”他不屑地说。

meaning: adv. 在床上; n. (Abed)人名；(法)阿贝；(阿拉伯)阿比德
example: By night, the furnaces glowed and the hammers clanged long after townsfolk were abed.
translation: 到晚上, 直到夜深人静以后许久,工厂里仍是炉火熊熊,铁锤丁当.

meaning: adj. 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的
example: Her book paints a bleak picture of the problems women now face.
translation: 她的书是女性当下所面临问题的凄凉写照。

meaning: n. 蛋白质；朊; adj. 蛋白质的
example: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process.
translation: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。

meaning: adj. 固定的；沉着的；沉静的；古板的，保守的
example: Be familiar with the robot ( automotive assembly ) production line. Good with hands, staidness, carefulness, good patience.
translation: 熟悉机器人 ( 自动装配线 ) 生产, 动手能力强, 工作认真 、 仔细, 有耐心.

meaning: n. 虚伪；伪善
example: The baron became increasingly heated over the hypocrisy of it all.
translation: 男爵对整件事的虚伪感到越来越生气。

meaning: v. 解雇；卸下；放出；免除; n. 排放；卸货；解雇
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

meaning: n. 琐事；蛋糕；少量; v. 开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄
example: The guests had each paid £250, no trifling sum.
translation: 客人每位付了250英镑，可不是一笔小数目。

meaning: n. 棱镜；[晶体][数] 棱柱
example: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
translation: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。

meaning: n. 圆周；周长；胸围
example: the circumference of the earth
translation: 地球的周长

meaning: v. 刷新；再磨光
example: Some manufacturers refurbish products themselves and others use qualified third party partners.
translation: 一些生产厂家翻新产品本身和其他人使用合格的第三方合作伙伴.

meaning: n. [化学] 溶质；[化学] 溶解物; adj. 溶解的
example: The army was ideologically opposed to the kind of economic solution proposed.
translation: 军方从意识形态角度出发反对所提议的经济方案。

meaning: n. 突降法；虎头蛇尾；令人扫兴的结尾
example: Barry's speech followed Dirk Bogarde's appearance, and was an inevitable anticlimax.
translation: 巴里紧随德克·博加德之后发表了演讲，不出所料，演讲顿时变得索然无味。

meaning: n. 微怒；小争执; v. 使……恼怒
example: His criminal plan didn't carry through , that drove him in a miff.
translation: 罪恶的计划没有实现, 让他恼羞成怒.

meaning: adj. 可比较的；比得上的
example: In other comparable countries real wages increased much more rapidly.
translation: 在其他具有可比性的国家，实际工资上涨更快。

meaning: adj. 原始的；初期的（等于primaeval）
example: The railway cuts through a primeval forest.
translation: 铁路穿越原始森林.

meaning: n. 欧姆（电阻单位）
example: The electric resistance is measured in ohm.
translation: 电阻的测量单位是欧姆。

meaning: v. 预示；画…的轮廓；遮蔽
example: The recent development adumbrate a world - wide revolution in computer technology.
translation: 最新事态的发展预示着一场全球性的计算机技术革命.

meaning: n. [电] 电压
example: The photoelectric transition property of Silicon photo - voltaic Cell was examined theoreticallyand experimentally.
translation: 从理论和实验上探讨了硅光电池的光电转换性能.

meaning: v. 同情，怜悯
example: You'd better commiserate John on his recent misfortunes.
translation: 你最好对约翰最近的不幸表示同情.

meaning: v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；愚弄; n. 嘲笑；笑柄；愚弄
example: The process of judicial selection was held up to ridicule.
translation: 司法选举的过程成为了笑柄。

meaning: n. 偶然性；[安全] 意外事故；可能性；[审计] 意外开支；[离散数学或逻辑学]偶然式
example: We have contingency plans.
translation: 我们有应急方案。

meaning: adj. 笨拙的；不雅的; adv. 笨拙地；不雅地
n. 控告，指控；谴责
example: The government denied the accusation that it was involved in the murders.
translation: 政府否认了参与谋杀案的指控。

meaning: adj. 做作的，不自然的
example: He had grown staid and dull.
translation: 他变得既古板又无趣.

meaning: adj. 类似的；同类的；同族的; n. (Akin)人名；(土、瑞典、尼日利)阿金；(匈)奥金；(英)埃金
example: This process is akin to piecing together a jigsaw puzzle.
translation: 这个过程和拼图相似。

meaning: n. 皮下注射；皮下注射器; adj. 皮下的
example: He held up a hypodermic to check the dosage.
translation: 他举起一个注射器查看剂量。

meaning: adj. 忘恩的；不知恩的; n. 忘恩负义的人
example: It would take an ingrate great courage to work on ways to dispel such measures.
translation: 一个不知感激为何物的人理直气壮的否定这些措施.

meaning: adj. 不容置疑的；明确的
example: The indubitable evidence we produced bore down our opponents in the debate.
translation: 我们在辩论中提出的不容置疑的证据,击败了对方.

meaning: v. 征服；抑制；减轻
example: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
translation: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

meaning: adj. 固执的，坚强的；坚定不移的；坚硬无比的; n. 坚硬的东西；坚石
example: The Americans are adamant that they will not budge on this point.
translation: 美国人非常强硬，他们在这一点上是不会妥协的。

meaning: adj. 几何学的；[数] 几何学图形的
example: Geometric designs were popular wall decorations in the 14th century.
translation: 14世纪，几何图形是风靡一时的墙壁装饰图案。

meaning: n. [数] 除法；部门；分配；分割；师（军队）；赛区
example: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
translation: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

meaning: n. 导弹；投射物; adj. 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
example: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

meaning: v. 容纳；使适应；供应；调解
example: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers.
translation: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

meaning: n. 阳极（电解）
v. 抚慰；怀柔；使和解
example: The concessions did little to placate the students.
translation: 让步根本未能平息学生的愤怒。

meaning: n. 沼泽；湿地; v. 使陷于沼泽；使沉没；使陷入困境
example: But a good chunk of it is swampland.
translation: 但州内大部分地区却是沼泽地.

meaning: v. 不予重视；将轻描淡写
adj. 肥胖的，过胖的
example: The old man is really obese; it can't be healthy.
translation: 那位老人确实过于肥胖了, 不能算是健康.

meaning: n. 约会；约会地点；集结地; v. 会合；约会
example: He failed to keep a rendezvous after sensing a police trap.
translation: 他察觉到警方设了圈套以后就没有如约会面。

meaning: n. 垄断；垄断者；专卖权
example: "Monopoly" is one of the best-selling games of all time.
translation: “大富翁”是有史以来最畅销的游戏之一。

meaning: n. 愤怒；激怒
example: She was exceedingly wrathful and struck at Hurstwood, who dodged.
translation: 她愤怒至极,对着赫斯渥就是一棍子, 赫斯渥躲开了.

meaning: adj. 秘密的；鬼鬼祟祟的；暗中的
example: Surreptitiously Mark looked at his watch.
translation: 马克偷偷看了看表。

meaning: adj. 极小的；很早的; n. 一点点
example: Scoop the blanket weed out and use it to line hanging baskets.
translation: 把那些丝状水藻捞出来，垫在吊篮里。

meaning: adj. 怀旧的，回忆往事的；耽于回想的; n. 回忆录作者；回忆者
example: She bowed her head in a gesture somehow reminiscent of royalty.
translation: 她低头的姿势让人想起皇室风范。

meaning: v. 退位；放弃
example: Many parents simply abdicate all responsibility for their children.
translation: 许多父母对孩子简直是完全撒手不管。

meaning: v. 统一；使相同，使一致
n. （尤指宗教原因的）隐士；隐居者
example: Research has revealed him to be [ that he was ] a hermit.
translation: 调查结果表明他原是一位隐士.

meaning: adj. 省的；地方性的；偏狭的; n. 粗野的人；乡下人；外地人
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 支持；长枕; v. 支持；支撑
example: Britain is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
translation: 英国可以自由制定政策以振兴经济。

meaning: n. [化学] 氢
example: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
translation: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

meaning: n. 掺杂物; adj. 掺杂用的
example: OBJECTIVE To compare and identify Zaocys dhumnades and its adulterant Elaphe dione.
translation: 目的比较鉴别乌梢蛇与白条锦蛇.

meaning: v. 使变丑；损毁…的外形；使大为减色
example: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
translation: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

meaning: n. 律师；（加拿大）出庭律师（等于arrister-at-law）；（英）（有资格出席高等法庭并辩护的）专门律师
example: You've wanted to be a barrister since the year dot.
translation: 很久以前你就一直想成为一名辩护律师了。

meaning: adj. 本国的；地方的；用本地语写成的; n. 本地话，方言；动植物的俗名
example: The linnet chirps her vernal song.
translation: 红雀吱喳鸣叫着她春天的歌.

meaning: n. 争论；打架；磨损处; v. 使磨损；变得令人紧张、急躁
example: This kind of living was beginning to fray her nerves.
translation: 这种生活开始让她神经紧张。

meaning: adj. 迫切的；紧急的；苛求的
example: She became even more exigent over his pronunciation.
translation: 她对他的发音更为苛求了。

meaning: adj. 热切期望的；热心的；挂念的
example: He took her hand in greeting and asked solicitously how everything was.
translation: 他握着她的手表示问候，关切地问她一切是否都好。

meaning: n. 神化；崇拜，颂扬；尊奉为神
example: the apotheosis of a Roman Emperor
translation: 册封罗马皇帝为神

meaning: adj. 相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的
example: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
translation: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

meaning: adj. 平等主义的; n. 平等主义；平等主义者
example: People have long dreamt of an egalitarian society.
translation: 人们梦想有一个平等的社会,由来已久.

meaning: v. 恐吓，威胁；胁迫
example: "You have no right to intimidate this man," Alison continued.
translation: “你没有权利威胁这个人，”艾莉森接着说。

meaning: adj. 哀伤的；悲哀的
example: Somewhere in the audience an old woman's voice began plaintive wail.
translation: 观众席里,一位老太太伤心地哭起来.

meaning: n. 恶行，欺诈；无赖行为
example: Knavery may serve a turn, But honesty never fails.
translation: 欺诈或许暂时有用, 诚实却永远有用.

meaning: n. 浮力；轻快；轻松的心情；（股票）保持高价或回升
example: Air can be pumped into the diving suit to increase buoyancy.
translation: 可以给潜水衣充气以增大浮力。

meaning: adj. 一本正经的；自负的；死板的
example: She was wondering if she were not a cold, hard, priggish person.
translation: 她只是在琢磨,她是不是一个冷酷的, 硬心肠的, 自命不凡的人.

meaning: n. 怀疑；嫌疑；疑心；一点儿; vt. 怀疑
example: He reported that two suspicious-looking characters had approached Callendar.
translation: 他报告说两个形迹可疑的人曾跟卡伦德接触过。

meaning: adj. 轻微的，少量的；脆弱的；细长的；不重要的; v. 轻视，忽略；怠慢; n. 怠慢；轻蔑
example: She should concern herself to prevent his slighting the children.
translation: 她还要当心阻止他丢掉小孩不管.

meaning: n. 潜伏；潜在因素
example: Optimize for responsiveness; accommodate latency.
translation: 优化响应能力, 调节延迟时间.

meaning: n. 一夫多妻，一妻多夫，多配偶
example: The Mormons, organizing themselves in response to a religious vision, practiced polygamy in all their settlements.
translation: 摩门教徒按照宗教幻想而组织起来,他们在自己的所有村落里实行一夫多妻制.

meaning: n. 印记；痕迹；特征；版本说明; v. 加特征；刻上记号
example: The city bears the imprint of Japanese investment.
translation: 该市带有日本投资的深刻印记。

meaning: adj. 可怕的；惊人的；非常的
example: What frightful gossips people are, even one'sbest friends.
translation: 人们最爱散布流言蜚语，哪怕是自己最好的朋友也不例外。

meaning: n. 苦难；磨难；忧患
n. 混合；混杂；混合物; adj. 混合的；拼凑的
example: We communicated in a medley of foreign words and universal gestures.
translation: 我们边说着外语，边打着通用的手势进行交流。

meaning: n. 编年史作者；纪年表编者
n. 声誉；名望; vt. 使有声望
example: Mailly's work achieved little renown.
translation: 梅利的工作没有获得什么声誉。

meaning: v. 使…谦卑；降低…的品格；降低…的地位
example: The president is not willing to abase himself before the nation.
translation: 总统不愿在全国人民面前降低自己的威信.

meaning: v. 使困窘；使羞愧；使局促不安
example: The entire metropolitan center possessed a high and mighty air calculated to overawe and abash the common applicant.
translation: 整个市中心区有着一种高傲的神气,好像故意要让一些前来寻找职业的普通人感到惶恐不安.

meaning: n. 纪念品
example: This is just a little keepsake for your birthday.
translation: 这是我的一点小意思,送给你做生日礼物.

meaning: adj. 稀释的；淡的; v. 稀释；冲淡；削弱
example: The poisons seeping from Hanford's contaminated land quickly dilute in the water.
translation: 从汉福德受污染的土地里渗出的有毒物质很快就在水中稀释了。

meaning: adj. 不受影响的，无动于衷的；不能渗透的
example: The floorcovering you select will need to be impervious to water.
translation: 挑选的地板材料必须是防水的。

meaning: n. 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物
example: Nancy wasn't sure what to make of Mick's apology.
translation: 南希不知应该如何理解米克的道歉。

meaning: n. 功效，效力
example: Recent medical studies confirm the efficacy of a healthier lifestyle.
translation: 最新医学研究证实了较为健康的生活方式的好处。

meaning: n. 窘况，困境；状态
example: Hank explained our predicament.
translation: 汉克说明了我们的艰难处境。

meaning: n. 先见；预知
example: Over the years he's demonstrated a certain prescience in foreign affairs.
translation: 这些年来，他已经在外交事务方面表现出一定的预见性。

meaning: v. 受压缩小
example: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material.
translation: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

meaning: v. 后退；减弱
example: If untreated, the gums recede, become swollen and bleed.
translation: 如果不进行治疗，牙龈会开始萎缩、红肿和出血。

meaning: v. 移入
example: 10,000 people are expected to immigrate in the next two years.
translation: 接下来的两年里预计有10,000人会移民至此。

meaning: adj. 令人作呕的，令人厌恶的；自作多情的；淡而无味的
example: A sordid, sentimental plot unwinds, with an inevitable mawkish ending.
translation: 一段灰暗而感伤的情节慢慢展开，最后是一个不可避免的幼稚可笑的结局。

meaning: n. 沉思；注视；意图
example: A chastened Agassi flew home for a period of deep contemplation.
translation: 追悔莫及的阿加西坐飞机回家面壁思过去了。

meaning: v. 危及；使陷于危险
example: A victory for Allende would imperil our interests in the Western Hemisphere.
translation: 阿连德一旦获胜,就将危及我们在西半球的利益.

meaning: v. 服水土；适应新环境
example: I help them acclimate to living in the U.S.
translation: 我帮助他们适应在美国的生活。

meaning: adj. 试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的; n. 假设，试验
example: ASEAN has branched out tentatively into the security business.
translation: 东盟已经尝试将合作范围拓展到安全领域。

meaning: v. 胶化; n. [物化] 凝胶，胶体
example: This gel gives a beautiful shine to the hair.
translation: 这种发胶会使头发看上去有亮丽的光泽。

meaning: n. 盐；风趣，刺激性; adj. 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的; v. 用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化
example: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
translation: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

meaning: n. 反射；沉思；映象
example: On reflection, he says, he very much regrets the comments.
translation: 经过反省，他说自己对所作的评论感到非常后悔。

meaning: v. 减轻；减少；废除; n. (Abate)人名；(英、意、法、埃塞)阿巴特
example: We must abate the noise pollution in our city.
translation: 我们必须消除我们城里的噪音污染.

meaning: v. 强调；重读
example: Accentuate the word " accent " on the first syllable.
translation: 在 “ accent ” 一词的第一个音节上加重音符号.

meaning: adj. 无形的，触摸不到的；难以理解的
example: There are intangible benefits beyond a rise in the share price.
translation: 除股价上升之外还有无形利益。

meaning: n. 盛况；浮华；壮丽；夸耀
example: all the pomp and ceremony of a royal wedding
translation: 王室婚礼的盛大场面与仪式

meaning: n. 厌恶人类；厌世，愤世嫉俗
n. 区域，地区；面积；范围
example: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

meaning: adj. 错误的；不正确的
example: I thought my answer was correct, but it was erroneous.
translation: 我原以为我的答案是对的, 可结果却是错的.

meaning: adj. 悔改的；后悔的
example: He was feeling guilty and depressed, repentant and scared.
translation: 他感到内疚、沮丧、后悔和害怕。

meaning: adj. 丰盛的，丰富的; n. 缓冲器，保险杆，减震物; vt. 装满；为…祝酒; vi. 干杯
example: Hey, I know what, I'll get a bumper sticker printed up.
translation: 嘿，有了，我会找人印刷一些保险杠贴纸。

meaning: n. 假设
example: The results confirmed his hypothesis on the use of modal verbs.
translation: 结果证实了他的关于情态动词用法的假设.

meaning: n. 学科；纪律；训练；惩罚; v. 训练，训导；惩戒
example: To start a revolution, you need discipline, incisiveness and articulacy.
translation: 要革命，就要守纪律、看得远、善表达。

meaning: n. 规则性；整齐；正规；匀称
example: Experimenters have succeeded in controlling the rate and regularity of the heartbeat.
translation: 实验者已经成功控制了心跳的速度和频率。

meaning: n. 分数；部分；小部分；稍微
example: If a stranger stops you, just wind the window down a fraction.
translation: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

meaning: n. 恢复；复位；王政复辟；归还
example: The restoration took almost 4,000 man-hours over four years.
translation: 修复工作历时4年，耗费近4,000工时。

meaning: adj. 荒凉的；无人烟的; v. 使荒凉；使孤寂
example: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
translation: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

meaning: adv. 仍然；更；静止地; adj. 静止的，不动的；寂静的，平静的；不起泡的; n. 寂静；剧照；蒸馏室; conj. 仍然；但是；尽管如此; v. 蒸馏；使…静止；使…平静下来
example: The rate of Prgnancy - induced hypertension syndrome, polyhydramnios, dystocia , fetal death , stillbirth, fetal macrosomia increased owing GDM.
translation: 糖尿病对妊娠的影响可使妊高征 、 羊水过多 、 难产 、 死胎、死产 、 巨大儿等发生率增加.

meaning: n. 疫苗；牛痘苗; adj. 疫苗的；牛痘的
example: influenza vaccine
translation: 流感疫苗

meaning: n. 健忘症，[内科] 记忆缺失
example: Conveniently, he had developed amnesia about that part of his life.
translation: 他得了健忘症，记不起那一段生活了，倒也省心了。

meaning: n. 大合唱；（意）清唱剧；康塔塔（一种声乐套曲）
example: The music of the song has been rearranged for the cantata.
translation: 这支歌改编已成大合唱.

meaning: n. 预言者；占兆官；占卜师; v. 预言；是…的预兆
example: Already there were problems. It didn't augur well.
translation: 已经有问题了，这不是好兆头。

meaning: adj. 仪式的；正式的，礼仪的; n. 仪式，礼节
example: Up to now the post of president has been largely ceremonial.
translation: 到目前为止，总统一职在很大程度上只是礼仪性的。

meaning: adj. 臭的；恶臭的；腐臭的
example: The air of the room was fetid with stale tobacco smoke.
translation: 房间里的空气有陈烟的臭味.

meaning: v. 颂扬；称赞
example: I eulogize the tall and straight trunk of the white poplar.
translation: 我赞美白杨树那挺拔的树干.

meaning: adj. 神秘的；高深莫测的；谜一般的
n. 报复（行为）；报复性劫掠
example: There were fears that some of the Western hostages might be killed in reprisal.
translation: 有人担心一些西方人质可能会受到报复性杀害。

meaning: adj. 淘气的；（人、行为等）恶作剧的；有害的
example: Berg tilts his head and a mischievous look crosses his face.
translation: 伯格侧着头，脸上掠过一丝调皮的神情。

meaning: v. 驱使；激怒；煽动；惹起
example: If one firm goes under it could provoke a cascade of bankruptcies.
translation: 如果一家公司倒闭，便有可能引发一连串的破产。

meaning: adj. [核] 放射性的；有辐射的
example: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
translation: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

meaning: n. 赎回；拯救；偿还；实践
example: I have no doubt that we are polluting the environment beyond redemption.
translation: 我丝毫都不怀疑我们对环境的污染是不可挽回的。

meaning: n. 机敏的应答；妙语；巧辩
example: He is very sharp, a quick thinker and swift with repartee.
translation: 他非常机敏，反应很快，并且能说会道。

meaning: adj. 光学的；视觉的；眼睛的; n. 眼睛；镜片
example: The reason for this is that the optic nerve is a part of the brain.
translation: 这其中的原因在于视神经是大脑的一部分。

meaning: n. 冒渎；亵渎圣物；悖理逆天的行为
example: It is a sacrilege to offend democracy.
translation: 违反民主是冒天下之大不韪。

meaning: n. 象征；徽章；符号; vt. 象征；用符号表示；用纹章装饰
example: The flame is a quasi-religious emblem of immortality.
translation: 火焰可以算作不朽的宗教象征。

meaning: v. 旋转；循环; adj. [植] 辐状的
example: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
translation: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

meaning: adj. 聚精会神的；勤勉的；勤苦工作的
example: Stimulate the hair to be toughness, balance the perspire the sedum.
translation: 平衡皮脂分泌,健胸丰胸,刺激、强健头皮,护发 、 生发.

meaning: n. 起初；获得学位
example: Since its inception the company has produced 53 different aircraft designs.
translation: 该公司自成立以来已经完成了53种不同样式飞行器的设计。

meaning: n. 生活；生存；存在
example: Objects the unalterable and the subsistent are one and the same.
translation: 027不变者、实存者和对象是一个东西.

meaning: n. 折射；折光
example: The seismic methods, reflection and refraction, are currently used in mining exploration.
translation: 地震法包括反射波法和折射波法, 常用于金属矿勘探.

meaning: adj. 感觉上的，依感观的；诉诸美感的
example: The nose was straight, the mouth sensuously wide and full.
translation: 鼻子直挺，嘴巴大而饱满，很性感。

meaning: n. [有化] 乳糖
example: Lactose is the main carbohydrate occurring in milk.
translation: 乳糖是乳的主要碳水化合物.

meaning: n. 战术家；谋士
adj. 猥亵的；下流的；卖淫的
example: We got arrested once, for singing bawdy songs in a cemetery.
translation: 我们曾经因为在公墓唱下流歌曲而被拘留过一次。

meaning: n. 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: n. 举止；行为；态度
example: lessons for young ladies in deportment and etiquette
translation: 年轻女士的礼仪课

meaning: adj. 静脉的；有脉纹的
example: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.
translation: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。

meaning: n. [法] 仲裁者；裁决人
example: He was the ultimate arbiter on both theological and political matters.
translation: 他在神学和政治事务上都是最终的仲裁人。

meaning: adj. 肥沃的；多产的；丰饶的；生殖力旺盛的
example: Large animals are less fecund than small ones.
translation: 大动物没有小动物繁殖能力强。

meaning: n. 发生；出现；事件；发现
example: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.
translation: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。

meaning: adj. 吵闹的；骚乱的；狂暴的
example: A mighty spirit of revolt heaved tumultuously within him.
translation: 一股强有力的反抗精神在他身子里排山倒海似的汹涌起来.

meaning: n. 漫步；曲流（常用复数）; v. 漫步；蜿蜒缓慢流动
example: It's so restful to meander along Irish country roads.
translation: 沿着爱尔兰的乡间小路漫步是多么惬意。

meaning: n. 综合，[化学] 合成；综合体
example: There are many amino acids that the body cannot synthesise itself.
translation: 有许多种氨基酸人体自身不能合成.

meaning: n. 诱拐，绑架；诱导
example: Armed robbery and abduction have been on the increase countrywide.
translation: 持械抢劫和诱拐案的案发率在全国范围内都有所上升。

meaning: adj. 流出的；感情横溢的
example: He was effusive in his praise for the general.
translation: 他对那位将军极尽溢美之词。

meaning: v. 增加；夸大；强化
example: All he desired was to aggrandize his estate.
translation: 他所希望的只是扩充他的家业.

meaning: adj. 偷懒的；无计谋的；无能的
example: He had a shifty face and previous convictions.
translation: 他看起来贼眉鼠眼，而且有犯罪前科。

meaning: adj. 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 活力，生气；生命力，生动性
example: vigor and vitality
translation: 生机与活力

meaning: v. 厌恶；憎恨
n. 折扣；贴现率; v. 贴现；打折扣出售商品
example: I'll sell at a discount in return for a speedy sale.
translation: 为了尽快售出，我会打折销售。

meaning: n. 目的地，终点
example: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
translation: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

meaning: n. 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气; v. 加油；毒（死）
example: natural gas
translation: 天然气

meaning: adj. （主张等）站得住脚的；可维持的
adj. 傲慢的；自大的
example: He gave me a haughty look and walked away.
translation: 他向我摆出傲慢的表情后走开.

meaning: n. 年报；编年史；年鉴
example: It was published in the "Annals of Internal Medicine".
translation: 它发表在《内科医学年鉴》上。

meaning: v. 恳求，哀求；乞求，急切地要求得到
example: Let him go, I beseech you!
translation: 求求你让他走吧！

meaning: n. 理论家
example: The Reflection Concerning the Argument of " the Criticism " and " the Theorization "
translation: 论文标题:对 “ 理论的批评化 ” 和 “ 批评的理论化 ” 争论的反思.

meaning: v. 挫败；反对；阻碍；横过; adj. 横放的；固执的; n. 划手座；独木舟的横梁; adv. 横过; prep. 横过
adj. 易于管教的；易驾驭的；易处理的；驯良的
n. 退休金，抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费; v. 发给养老金或抚恤金
example: He lived on an invalidity pension which came as a weekly giro.
translation: 他靠每周领取的作为病残养老金的直接转账救济支票过日子。

meaning: n. 放任；狂热; v. 遗弃；放弃
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: v. 减轻；使缓和；使平静
example: He did what he could to allay his wife's fears.
translation: 他竭尽所能来消除妻子的各种恐惧。

meaning: v. 窃取；偷窃
example: Hermione Granger: Filch is gone.
translation: 赫敏·格兰杰: 费尔奇走了.

meaning: adj. 新奇的；异常的; n. 小说
example: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
translation: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

meaning: n. 间隙；缺口；差距；分歧; v. 裂开
example: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
translation: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

meaning: n. 充裕，丰富
example: The shallow sea bed yields up an abundance of food.
translation: 浅海床提供了丰富的食物。

meaning: n. 创造，创作；创作物，产物
example: The manifesto gives pride of place to job creation.
translation: 这项宣言将创造工作机会放在首位。

meaning: n. 人类；人道；仁慈；人文学科
example: We admire her dedication to the cause of humanity.
translation: 我们敬佩她对人类事业的献身精神。

meaning: v. 靠；依赖；斜倚
example: Recline & Sprawl is an amusingly named furniture shop in London.
translation: Recline&Sprawl是伦敦一家店名有趣的家具店。

meaning: n. 片刻，瞬间，时刻；重要，契机
example: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
translation: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

meaning: adj. 相关的，相干的；中肯的；切题的
example: Mrs Southern listened keenly, occasionally breaking in with pertinent questions.
translation: 萨瑟恩夫人兴致勃勃地听着，间或插话问一些相关的问题。

meaning: adj. 尖刻的；锐利的；苛刻的；锋利的（名词trenchancy，副词trenchantly）; n. (Trenchant)人名；(法)特朗尚
example: She complained that Mrs. Trencher was a tireless and aggressive gossip.
translation: 地埋怨特连卓尔太太是个从来就不知疲倦,不顾别人的长舌妇.

meaning: v. 证明，表明；显示; n. 载货单，货单；旅客名单; adj. 显然的，明显的；明白的
example: Their frustration and anger will manifest itself in crying and screaming.
translation: 他们用哭泣与尖叫表达自己的沮丧和愤怒。

meaning: n. [医] 尸体；死尸
example: Examination of a cadaver is to determine the cause of death.
translation: 尸体解剖是为了确认死亡原因。

meaning: v. 停滞；淤塞；变萧条
example: Stagnation in home sales is holding back economic recovery.
translation: 国内销售的停滞不前正阻碍着经济复苏。

meaning: adj. 干旱的；不毛的，[农] 荒芜的
example: Many black Namibians are subsistence farmers who live in the arid borderlands.
translation: 许多生活在土地贫瘠的边境地区的纳米比亚黑人农场主的收成仅够维持自身的口粮。

meaning: n. 精通，熟练
example: His proficiency as a surgeon is well known.

meaning: n. 摄影；摄影术
example: My hobbies are letter writing, foot-ball, music, photography, and tennis.
translation: 我的业余爱好是写信、踢足球、听音乐、玩摄影和打网球。

meaning: n. 冲动；[电子] 脉冲；刺激；神经冲动；推动力; vt. 推动
example: All day she had fought off the impulse to telephone Harry.
translation: 她一整天都在克制自己想给哈里打电话的冲动。

meaning: n. 设施；设备；容易；灵巧
example: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
translation: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

meaning: adj. 等距的；距离相等的
n. 铁轨；扶手；横杆；围栏; v. 抱怨；责骂
example: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
translation: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

meaning: adj. 一定的；确切的
example: Her Royal Highness has definite views about most things.
translation: 女王陛下对大多数事情都有明确的观点。

meaning: v. 激怒；搅浑；惹怒; n. (Rile)人名；(塞)里莱
example: Nothing ever seemed to rile him.
translation: 好像从来没有什么事让他烦恼。

meaning: adj. 停滞的；不景气的；污浊的；迟钝的
example: stagnant water
translation: 积水；死水；滞水；停滞水；静水

meaning: adj. 恶意的；有害的
example: He turned his baleful glare on the cowering suspect.
translation: 他恶毒地盯着那个蜷缩成一团的嫌疑犯.

meaning: v. 剥夺；使裸露
adj. 粗野的；粗鲁的；粗鄙的；笨拙的；乡土气的
example: Patrick's boorish rudeness soon drove Monica's friends away.
translation: 帕特里克的粗鲁无礼很快使得莫妮卡的朋友们想走了。

meaning: adj. 减弱的；稀薄的；细小的; v. 使减弱；使纤细
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: adj. 唐吉诃德式的；狂想家的；愚侠的
example: He has always lived his life by a hopelessly quixotic code of honour.
translation: 他生活中一直遵循一种完全不切实际的堂吉诃德式的道德准则。

meaning: n. 葡萄园，葡萄温室
example: The Chablis vineyard is the northernmost in Burgundy.
translation: 沙布利葡萄园在勃艮第的最北边。

meaning: adj. 背信弃义的；不忠的
example: Their feet will trample on the dead bodies of their perfidious aggressors.
translation: 他们将从背信弃义的侵略者的尸体上踏过。

meaning: v. 撞击；侵犯
example: He never allowed his work to impinge on his private life.
translation: 他从不让他的工作妨碍私生活。

meaning: v. 使发芽；使生长
example: Some seed varieties germinate fast, so check every day or so.
translation: 有一些种子发芽快，所以差不多每天得察看一下。

meaning: n. 杂耍；轻歌舞剧；歌舞杂耍表演
example: Mary is a vaudevillian.
translation: 玛丽是一个杂耍演员.

meaning: adj. 粘的；粘性的；胶状的
example: The meat was chewy and the sauce was glutinous and tasted artificial.
translation: 肉嚼不烂，酱汁黏稠，味道也不自然。

meaning: adj. 柔软的；灵活的；顺从的；易弯曲的；逢迎的; v. 使柔软；使顺从; n. (Supple)人名；(意、西)苏普莱
adj. 去湿的，使干燥的; n. [助剂] 干燥剂
example: From the increase in the weight of the desiccant the absolute humidity can be determined.
translation: 可从干燥剂重量的增加来确定绝对温度.

meaning: v. 熏陶；启发；教诲
example: They tried to edify the child with music.
translation: 他们试图用音乐陶冶这孩子.

meaning: n. 暴动；煽动性的言论或行为；妨害治安
v. 调用；祈求；引起；恳求
example: He has even had the temerity to invoke the names of Martin Luther King Jr and Malcolm X in defence of his actions.
translation: 他竟然敢搬出马丁·路德·金和马尔科姆·艾克斯的名字来为自己的行为辩解。

meaning: v. 掩饰；与…不符；使失望；证明…虚假错误
example: The facts of the situation belie his testimony.
translation: 实际情况证明他作了伪证。

meaning: adj. 宽敞的；方便的
example: Guestrooms are commodious and well-appointed.
translation: 客房宽敞舒适且陈设考究。

meaning: adj. 无比的；无双的；空前未有的
example: I must ask a question you may find unpardonable.
translation: 我必须要问一个你可能觉得颇具冒犯性的问题。

meaning: adj. [生理] 阈下的；潜在意识的；微小得难以察觉的; n. 潜意识；阈下意识
n. 张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压; vt. 使紧张；使拉紧
example: This is the result of tensional or compressional forces originating from tectonic movement.
translation: 当岩石受到因地壳板块移动而产生的张力或横压力时,断层便会出现.

meaning: v. 摘要；概括；成为…的缩影
example: As a result, this passage will epitomize and introduce some main viewpoints.
translation: 研究者对于情绪智力诸多方面如概念,测量等持有不同观点, 本文将摘要简介.

meaning: adj. 季度的，按季度的；一年四次的; adv. 按季度，[农] 一季一次地；纵横四分地; n. 季刊
example: In 1987 Congressional Quarterly published a series of guidebooks to American politics.
translation: 1987年《国会季刊》出版了一系列美国政治指南读物。

meaning: n. [分化] 烧瓶；长颈瓶，细颈瓶；酒瓶，携带瓶
example: The flask is completely watertight, even when laid on its side.
translation: 即使平放，这个真空水杯也是滴水不漏。

meaning: adj. 冷静的，清醒的；未醉的; v. 使严肃；使醒酒，使清醒; n. (Sober)人名；(英)索伯
example: sober up
translation: 清醒起来；使…清醒；使严肃起来

meaning: adj. 似是而非的；外表美观的；华而不实的；徒有其表的
adj. 非常高兴的；欢跃的；狂喜的；欢欣鼓舞的
example: An exultant party leader said: "He will be an excellent MP."
translation: 一位满面喜色的政党领袖说：“他会成为一名出色的议员。”

meaning: adj. 险恶的；气候严酷的；狂风暴雨的
example: They made detailed plans for an outing, but they reckoned without the possibility of inclement weather.
translation: 他们为郊游拟订了周详的计划, 但他们还是忽略了天气变坏的可能性.

meaning: n. 地球上处于正相对应的两个地区，尤指（与欧洲形成对跖地的）澳大拉西亚
example: The antipodes of love is hatred.
translation: 爱的反面是恨.

meaning: v. 把缆绳拴在系索栓上; n. (Belay)人名；(法)贝莱
example: Our guides belay us.
translation: 我们的响导把我们系在绳子的一端.

meaning: v. 慷慨陈词；演讲；朗读
example: He used to declaim French verse to us.
translation: 他过去常给我们朗诵法语诗歌。

meaning: adj. 诙谐的；开玩笑的
example: Dr. Daniel was a gleg man of a jocose nature.
translation: 丹尼尔大夫是一位天生诙谐而反应机敏的人.

meaning: adj. 占有的；所有的；所有格的；占有欲强的; n. 所有格
example: Danny could be very jealous and possessive about me.
translation: 丹尼很爱吃醋，对我的占有欲很强。

meaning: v. 充分满足；使厌腻; adj. 饱足的；厌腻的
example: Hunting is usually initiated by hunger and stopped by satiation.
translation: 追逐现象通常是由饥饿所引起的,并由于饱食而停止.

meaning: v. 作弊；行为不礼貌
example: When your children misbehave tell them without making them feel small.
translation: 孩子表现不佳时要让他们知道，但不能让他们自惭形秽。

meaning: n. [车辆] 三轮车
example: motor tricycle
translation: 机动三轮车；三轮摩托车

meaning: n. 解剖；解剖学；剖析；骨骼
example: This was a troubling essay on the anatomy of nationhood.
translation: 这是一篇剖析民族主义的让人不安的文章。

meaning: n. 仇外；害怕生人者；畏惧和憎恨外国人的人
example: Xenophobic nationalism is on the rise in some West European countries.
translation: 西欧一些国家的仇外民族主义有所抬头。

meaning: v. 毁灭；毁坏
example: This September I was invited to devastate the moors of a friend in the north.
translation: 这年九月我被北方一个朋友邀请去遨游他的原野.

meaning: adj. 敏捷的；机敏的；活泼的
example: She is such an agile dancer!
translation: 她跳起舞来是那么灵巧!

meaning: n. [药] 镇静剂；能使安静的东西；止痛药; adj. 使镇静的；使安静的
v. 争；竞争; n. (Vie)人名；(英)维
example: vie for
translation: 争夺；竞争

meaning: n. 立法者
example: As a result, legislator employ various procedual devices to handle knotty problems.
translation: 结果, 议员们便采取种种程序性的手法来对付棘手的问题.

meaning: n. 讽刺；讽刺文学，讽刺作品
example: Looking at her satiric parent she only gave a little laugh.
translation: 她望着她那挖苦人的父亲,只讪讪地笑了一下.

meaning: adj. 回答的；应答的; n. [法] 被告；应答者
example: Both the petitioner and respondent provide for the upkeep of the children.
translation: 离婚上诉方和被告方共同抚养子女。

meaning: n. 小儿科
example: He received a Bachelor's drgee of Pediatrics.
translation: 他获得了小儿科学士学位。

meaning: v. 讽刺；挖苦
example: He tried hard not to smile in smug self-satisfaction.
translation: 他强忍住沾沾自喜的笑容。

meaning: adj. 疲惫的；耗尽的; v. 耗尽；用尽；使…精疲力尽（exhaust的过去式）
example: The ship's crew were now exhausted and utterly demoralized.
translation: 这艘船上的船员现在都已精疲力竭，彻底丧失了信心。

meaning: n. 轻视，蔑视；耻辱
example: Mr. Kelly was sentenced to six months in prison for contempt.
translation: 凯利先生因藐视法庭被判6个月监禁。

meaning: adj. 可怕的；丑恶的
example: His family was subjected to a hideous attack by the gang.
translation: 他的家人遭到了匪帮的恐怖袭击。

meaning: adj. 有罪的；内疚的
example: Striker Alan Smith was guilty of two glaring misses.
translation: 前锋艾伦·史密斯两次严重失误，将球射偏。

meaning: adj. 迟钝的；圆头的；不锋利的
example: I'm a limited and obtuse clergyman while you're the expert.
translation: 你是专家，而我是个能力有限的愚笨牧师。

meaning: adj. 时代错误的
example: Many of its practices seem anachronistic.
translation: 它的很多习俗显得落伍过时。

meaning: n. 桌子；表格；平地层; v. 制表；搁置；嵌合; adj. 桌子的
example: They admired the tableau of the Nativity.
translation: 他们欣赏着耶稣降生的场景造型。

meaning: adj. 规定的；有时效的; n. 规定；命令
example: It takes effect when man obeys the prescript without being disturbed by his perceptual knowledge.
translation: 道德力之所以具有存在的可能性,主要是由其所独具的特质决定的.

meaning: v. 吸收，接受；喝；吸入
example: A man's shoes get tight by imbibe water, but he do not.
translation: 人穿的鞋子会因吸饱了水而变紧,惟其本人则不会(醉).

meaning: v. 举出；引证
example: You must adduce a lot of examples to support your argument.
translation: 你必须引用许多例证来证明你的观点.

meaning: adj. 沸腾的；激昂的; n. 沸腾；煮沸；起泡; adv. 沸腾
example: Water can be purified by boiling for five minutes.
translation: 水煮沸5分钟便可得到净化。

meaning: adj. 不知情的；不知不觉的，无意的; v. 使精神错乱；使丧失智能（unwit的ing形式）
example: He had been unwittingly deluded by their mystical nonsense.
translation: 他不知不觉被他们故弄玄虚的胡说八道给骗了。

meaning: adj. 羞怯的；缺乏自信的；谦虚谨慎的
example: diffident about
translation: 对…缺乏自信心

meaning: n. 座右铭，格言；箴言
example: Our motto is "Plan for the worst and hope for the best".
translation: 我们的格言是“做最坏的打算，抱最大的希望”。

meaning: n. 立方；立方体；骰子; v. 使成立方形；使自乘二次；量…的体积
example: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
translation: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。

meaning: adj. 狂热的；发狂的; n. 疯子；狂人
example: a scene of frenetic activity
translation: 疯狂活动的场面

meaning: n. 恩人；捐助者；施主
example: In his old age he became a benefactor of the arts.
translation: 他晚年成了一个艺术赞助人。

meaning: n. 暗示；略知；模糊概念; v. 暗示 （inkle的ing形式）；略知；低声说出
example: We had an inkling that something might be happening.
translation: 我们隐约感觉可能正有什么事情发生。

meaning: n. 母权制；女家长制；女族长制；母系氏族
example: That is due to the matriarchy of its society.
translation: 那是因为他们仍然是母系社会。

meaning: n. 僵局；死路
example: The proposal offered both sides a way out of the diplomatic impasse.
translation: 这一提议使双方都能摆脫外交僵局.

meaning: n. 疑问，质问；疑问号 ；[计] 查询; v. 询问；对……表示疑问
example: query language
translation: 查询语言

meaning: v. 删除，删去
example: He is capabled of bring out an expurgate edit 0 ion of wordsworth.
translation: 他几乎做的出出版华兹华斯作品的删改本(洁本).

meaning: v. 使迷恋，使倾心
adj. 双的；双重的; n. 双数；双数词
example: his dual role as composer and conductor
translation: 他兼任作曲家和指挥的双重角色

meaning: n. 狂热入迷者；盲信者；盲信; adj. 狂热的；盲信的
example: I am not a religious fanatic but I am a Christian.
translation: 我不是宗教狂热分子，但我是基督徒。

meaning: n. 颗粒；[物] 质点；极小量；小品词
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

meaning: adj. 有滋味的；有趣的
adj. 排斥的；防水的；弹回的；令人讨厌的; n. 防护剂；防水布；排斥力
example: She still found the place repellent.
translation: 她还是觉得这个地方令人厌恶。

meaning: adj. 封建制度的；领地的；世仇的
example: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords.
translation: 他天生擅长交际：他的祖先曾是封建领主。

meaning: n. 【物】速度
example: Cyclists pedal their bikes furiously when riding in the velodrome on a track with banked turns.
translation: 选手在带有倾斜弯道轨道的室内赛车场地上拼命地蹬他们的自行车.

meaning: n. 假货；骗子；假动作; v. 捏造；假装…的样子; adj. 伪造的
example: They said, after digging around, the photo was a fake.
translation: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

meaning: v. 简化；使单纯；使简易
example: Division of mankind into workingman and capitalists suffers from the fallacy of simplism.
translation: 硬把人类分成工人阶级和资本阶级就犯了过分简单化的错误.

meaning: v. 复发；重现；采用；再来；循环；递归
example: Economic crises recur periodically.
translation: 经济危机周期性地发生.

meaning: adj. 垂头丧气的，气馁的
example: He gathered himself up and sneaked off, crushed and crestfallen.
translation: 他爬起来,偷偷地溜了,一副垂头丧气 、 被斗败的样子.

meaning: n. 代数学
example: She is fascinated by algebra while he considers it meaningless nonsense.
translation: 她对代数非常着迷，而他却认为代数毫无意义。

meaning: n. 专制，独裁；专制国家
example: How do we choose between autarchy and corrupt democracy?
translation: “清廉的专制”与“腐败的民主”之间如何选择?

meaning: adj. 巨大的，庞大的
example: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
translation: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

meaning: v. 遗弃；放弃；逃跑; n. 沙漠；荒原；应得的赏罚; adj. 沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的
example: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
translation: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

meaning: n. 宿营地；兵营
example: Our people's liberation army is now in the cantonment.
translation: 我们的人民解决军现在正在宿营地.

meaning: n. [数] 十角形；[数] 十边形
example: A polygon with ten sides is a decagon.
translation: 十条边的形状叫十边形。

meaning: n. 标题；字幕；说明；逮捕; v. 加上说明；加上标题
example: I didn't understand the drawing until I read the caption.
translation: 直到我看到这幅画的说明才弄懂其意思.

meaning: adj. 公正的；无偏见的
example: unbiased estimator
translation: 无偏估计值

meaning: n. 结晶，晶体；水晶；水晶饰品; adj. 水晶的；透明的，清澈的
example: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
translation: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

meaning: v. 拆除；破坏；毁坏；推翻；驳倒
example: Our intention was to demolish the rumours that have surrounded him.
translation: 我们的目的是要彻底击破围绕他的那些谣言。

meaning: v. 闲聊；胡说；小孩般说话; n. 无聊话；咿咿呀呀声
example: What a bore it was to listen to the woman's prattle!
translation: 听那个女人唠叨真烦人！

meaning: n. 厚颜无耻
example: He had the effrontery to say I was lying.
translation: 他竟敢说我撒谎.

meaning: n. 强心剂；强胃剂; adj. 心脏的；心脏病的；贲门的
example: He died of cardiac arrest after snorting cocaine.
translation: 他死于吸食可卡因之后的心脏停搏。

meaning: n. 事后的想法；后来添加的东西
example: Almost as an afterthought he added that he missed her.
translation: 他又几乎不假思索地补充说他想念她。

meaning: adj. 虚荣心强的；非常自负的
example: The whole immoral conducts almost is wear vainglory around but living.
translation: 一切恶行几乎都是围绕着虚荣而生的.

meaning: n. 害虫；寄生虫；歹徒
v. 支付；支出
example: Cashiers receive and disburse money in establishments other than financial institutions.
translation: 除了金融机构,出纳员也会在一些社会机构里收款付款.

meaning: n. 广告客户；刊登广告的人
example: The city directory showed no such return address as the advertiser had left.
translation: 本市的住址簿上查不到登启事人留下的那个回信地址.

meaning: n. 外交家，外交官；有外交手腕的人；处事圆滑机敏的人
example: Fearey had all the charm and urbanity of the trained diplomat.
translation: 费尔里具备一个训练有素的外交官的一切风度和优雅。

meaning: adj. 和蔼可亲的；友善的
example: Mr Brooke is an extremely affable and approachable man.
translation: 布鲁克先生极为谦和，平易近人。

meaning: n. 类型；种类；体裁；样式；流派；风俗画; adj. 风俗画的；以日常情景为主题的
example: She emerges as a full, three-dimensional character in a way that few horror genre heroines ever do.
translation: 她作为一个丰满而又鲜活的人物形象展现在读者面前，之前的恐怖体裁作品中，很少有女主人公给人这种感觉。

meaning: n. 部门；扇形，扇区；象限仪；函数尺; vt. 把…分成扇形
example: The church can only go so far in secular matters.
translation: 教会在世俗事务上只能做这么多。

meaning: adj. 男性的；有男子气概的；刚健的; n. (Virile)人名；(意)维里莱
n. [解剖] 皮质；树皮；果皮
example: The infection - thread enters and branches in cells of the root cortex.
translation: 侵染线进入根的皮层细胞并进行分枝.

meaning: n. 优势；运星；支配地位; adj. 上升的；优越的
example: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
translation: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

meaning: n. 自负；要求；主张；借口；骄傲
example: We like him for his honesty, his lack of pretension.
translation: 我们喜欢他的诚实、不浮夸。

meaning: n. 人类学
example: Social anthropology is centrally concerned with the diversity of culture.
translation: 社会人类学主要关于文化多样性.

meaning: v. 排除；妨碍；阻止
example: We try to preclude any possibility of misunderstanding.
translation: 我们努力排除任何误解的可能性.

meaning: v. 挫败；扰乱，破坏；使…为难；使…破灭
adj. 持久的；永恒的; n. [纺] 厚实斜纹织物; v. 持续；维持（last的ing形式）
example: Only the achievement of these goals will bring lasting peace.
translation: 只有达成这些目标才会带来持久的和平。

meaning: n. 干涉，介入；插入，放入
example: It is equally impossible that we should behold such interposition in any form with indifference.
translation: 我们对于这种干涉,不论何种方式,都不能熟视无睹.

meaning: n. 理由；辩护；认为有理，认为正当；释罪
example: To me the only justification for a zoo is educational.
translation: 对我来说，动物园存在的唯一正当理由是其教育作用。

meaning: v. 属于；和……有关，有关系
example: Of all the great interest appertain to our country, that of union _ cordial.
translation: 在我们国家的重大利益之中最为重要的是我们热情 、 可信.

meaning: v. 从中作梗，阻挠；妨碍; n. 妨碍球
n. 听力，听觉；试听; v. 试听；试音
example: She wrote to Paramount Studios and asked if they would audition her.
translation: 她写信给派拉蒙电影公司，询问他们是否同意让她去试镜。

meaning: n. 不幸；灾祸，灾难
example: He has known great misfortune in his life.
translation: 他一生中经历过巨大的不幸。

meaning: v. 描绘…的特性；具有…的特征
example: the rolling hills that characterize this part of England
translation: 成为英格兰这一地区特征的绵延起伏的丘陵地

meaning: adj. 积极的；[数] 正的，[医][化学] 阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的; n. 正数；[摄] 正片
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 工作；[物] 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品; v. 使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进
example: Very slow - grown softwoods have excellent workability.
translation: 生长非常慢的针叶材有着特别好的加工性能.

meaning: adj. 复发的，再发作的
example: The patient presented with a case of recrudescent gastralgia.
translation: 患者的症状是复发性胃痛.

meaning: adj. 著名的；有名望的; v. 庆祝（celebrate的过去式和过去分词）
example: Pope John Paul celebrated mass today in a city in central Poland.
translation: 教皇保罗二世今天在波兰中部的一个城市主持了弥撒。

meaning: n. 方言，土话；同源语；行话；个人用语特征; adj. 方言的
example: In the fifties, many Italians spoke only local dialect.
translation: 在20世纪50年代，许多意大利人只会说当地方言。

meaning: adj. 全球的；总体的；球形的
example: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
translation: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

meaning: n. 陈词滥调；平凡；陈腐
example: The talk is no more than a platitude.
translation: 这番话无非是老生常谈.

meaning: v. 限制；约束；限定
example: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
translation: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

meaning: v. 歼灭；战胜；废止
example: The human race has enough weapons to annihilate itself.
translation: 人类有足够的武器灭绝自己。

meaning: n. [航]陆标；地标；界标；里程碑；纪念碑；地界标；划时代的事; adj. 有重大意义或影响的
example: The Ambassador Hotel is a Los Angeles landmark.
translation: 国宾大饭店是洛杉矶的地标性建筑之一。

meaning: v. 使胆寒；使惊骇
adj. 正义的；正直的；公正的
example: Aren't you afraid of being seen as a righteous crusader?
translation: 你不怕被人看作是一个装腔作势的改革者？

meaning: adj. 俯卧的；拜倒的；降伏的；沮丧的; v. 使…屈服；将…弄倒；使…俯伏
example: Immediately after my father's death my stepmother was prostrate.
translation: 我父亲死后，我的继母一下就垮了。

meaning: v. 促进；提升；推销；发扬
example: They have begun dialogues to promote better understanding between both communities.
translation: 双方已经开始了对话，以增进两个社群间的彼此了解。

meaning: adj. 折磨人的，痛苦的
adj. 有条件的；假定的; n. 条件句；条件语
example: Their support is conditional on his proposals meeting their approval.
translation: 他们的支持是以他的提案得到他们的批准为条件的。

meaning: adj. 神秘的，含义模糊的；[动] 隐藏的
example: He has issued a short, cryptic statement denying the spying charges.
translation: 他发表了一个简短隐晦的声明，否认对其间谍行为的指控。

meaning: adj. 生动的；保持原味的；适于赛跑的；猥亵的; n. (Racy)人名；(葡、阿拉伯)拉西
example: Her racy stories can be rather shocking.
translation: 她那些下流的故事讲起来有时很让人吃惊.

meaning: v. 包含；包围，环绕；完成
example: Note that these contours do not encompass the crack tip.
translation: 注意这些围道,都不包含裂信尖端.

meaning: v. 挥舞；炫耀; n. 挥舞
example: She answered with a brandish of her umbrella.
translation: 她挥动着伞回答.

meaning: n. 滑轮；皮带轮；滑车; vt. 用滑轮升起
example: The stone was lifted by means of a rope and pulley.
translation: 这块大石是用绳子和滑轮给吊起来的.

meaning: n. [动] 食草动物
example: Herbivore man is a dandy metrosexual with an abhorrence of martial arts.
translation: 食草男是时髦的都市美男,厌恶武术.

meaning: v. 给予选举权；给予自治权；解放，释放
example: The company voted to enfranchise its 120 women members.
translation: 公司投票决定给予其120名女职员选举权。

meaning: n. 渎职，违法行为；不正当，坏事
example: The mayor is condemned for the monstrous malfeasance of his administration.
translation: 由于其政府的荒谬违法行为,市长被宣告有罪.

meaning: n. 植物学；地区植物总称
example: Until 1982 he was senior lecturer in botany at Durham University.
translation: 1982年以前他一直是达勒姆大学生物系的高级讲师。

meaning: n. 优先；居先
example: She had to learn that her wishes did not take precedence over other people's needs.
translation: 她必须懂得，自己的愿望不能先于别人的需要。

meaning: v. 使成合金；使减低成色; n. 合金
example: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
translation: 黄铜是铜锌合金。

meaning: adj. 粗略的；草率的；匆忙的
v. 预示；预感；预兆
example: Black clouds forebode a storm.
translation: 乌云预示有暴风雨.

meaning: v. 分配；拨给；分派; n. (Allot)人名；(英)阿洛特；(西)阿略特；(法)阿洛
example: The government is ready to allot houses in that area.
translation: 政府准备在那个地区分配住房.

meaning: n. 血清；浆液；免疫血清；乳清；树液
example: serum albumin
translation: 血清白蛋白；血清清蛋白

meaning: adj. 意气相投的；性格相似的；适意的；一致的
example: He is back in more congenial company.
translation: 他回来后变得更容易相处了。

meaning: n. 火焰；热情；光辉; v. 焚烧；泛红
example: Intense balls of flame rose up into the sky.
translation: 炽热的火球冲上天空。

meaning: n. 分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录; v. 将…记录下来; adj. 微小的，详细的 [maɪˈnjuːt; US -ˈnuːt; maɪˋnut]
example: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
translation: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

meaning: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪
example: The snake uses its venom to stun or paralyze its victims.
translation: 蛇用其毒液使受害者失去知觉或瘫痪.

meaning: v. 伸出的
n. 图表；曲线图; v. 用曲线图表示
example: We plot about eight points on the graph.
translation: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。

meaning: v. 超过；胜过
example: Sometimes small firms can outdo big business when it comes to customer care.
translation: 在顾客服务方面，有时小企业可能优于大企业。

meaning: n. 长柄勺；浸染工；[鸟] 河鸟
example: The Big Dipper is not by itself a constellation.
translation: 北斗七星本身不是一个星座。

meaning: adj. 追溯的；有追溯效力的；反动的
v. 欺骗
example: He pleaded guilty to charges of conspiracy to defraud the government.
translation: 他承认了阴谋诈骗政府的罪名。

meaning: adj. 寒冷的，冬天的；冷淡的
n. 贪心，贪婪
example: Her cupidity is well known.
translation: 她的贪婪尽人皆知.

meaning: v. 删除；减少；紧缩开支
example: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.
translation: 不久之后，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。

meaning: v. 预示；成为…的前兆; n. 预兆
example: The disappointing sales figures foreshadow more redundancies.
translation: 令人失望的销售额预示着会有更多人被裁员。

meaning: n. 抗毒素；抗毒素血清
example: As diphtheria antitoxin is a foreign protein.
translation: 白喉抗毒素是并性蛋白.

meaning: v. 报复；回敬
example: He had authorisation from the military command to retaliate.
translation: 他得到军事指挥部授权，准备反击。

meaning: n. 满足；满意
example: He felt a sudden sense of calm, of contentment.
translation: 他突然感到一种安宁和满足.

meaning: adj. 稳健的，温和的；适度的，中等的；有节制的; v. 变缓和，变弱
example: Futures prices recovered from sharp early declines to end with moderate losses.
translation: 期货价格在早盘深幅下跌后出现反弹，收盘时未见严重损失。

meaning: adj. 内脏的；出于本能的；发自肺腑的；粗俗的
example: visceral organs
translation: 内脏；脏器（visceral organ的复数形式）

meaning: adj. 迟钝的；缺乏热情的；冷漠的
example: That contrast between flashy inspiration and stolidity may now apply to the world's big central banks.
translation: 而今这种创意的灵感和反应上的迟钝的对照也适用于世界上的各大中央银行.

meaning: n. [电] 验电器
example: Her electroscope was a metal case with two holes in its side.
translation: 她的验电器是一个金属盒子,旁边有两个小孔.

meaning: n. 殷勤；彬彬有礼；柔顺
example: She speaks with complaisance.
translation: 她说话彬彬有礼.

meaning: n. 发生；起源
example: We cannot yet satisfactorily explain the genesis of the universe.
translation: 我们仍不能令人满意地解释宇宙的起源.

meaning: v. 开脱；使无罪
example: He exculpate himself from stealing the money.
translation: 他自行辩白没有偷钱.

meaning: n. 宗族；部落；集团
example: The men mustered before their clan chiefs.
translation: 男人们聚集在族长们面前。

meaning: n. 同谋者，[法] 共犯
example: He was working alone and did not have an accomplice.
translation: 他在单干，没有同伙。

meaning: adj. 野蛮的；残酷的；狂怒的；荒凉的; n. 未开化的人；粗鲁的人；残暴成性的人; v. 乱咬；粗暴的对待
example: "What do you want!" she whispered savagely. "Get out."
translation: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”

meaning: adj. 偶然的，意外的；幸运的
example: Their success is the result of a fortuitous combination of circumstances.
translation: 他们的成功是各种环境因素偶然联系在一起的幸运产物。

meaning: v. 使卷缩；使卷曲; n. 卷发；吱吱响声
example: She watched the paper curl and frizzle and burn; and presently they were ashes.
translation: 她注视着纸片卷曲、焦枯、燃烧; 转眼间它们变成了灰烬.

meaning: n. 保存，保留
example: The entire city is under a preservation order.
translation: 整个城市都被纳入了保护令的保护范围。

meaning: adj. 同等的；相当于…的
adv. 不知不觉地；出其不意地；不料
n. [物] 光子；辐射量子；见光度（等于light quantum）
example: The chance that an electron absorbs more than one photon is negligible.
translation: 一个电子吸收一个以上的光子的机会是极少的.

meaning: adj. 好色的；淫荡的；挑动情欲的
example: The man was lascivious, sexually perverted and insatiable.
translation: 这个人是一个欲壑难填的变态色情狂。

meaning: adj. 外部的；表面的；[药] 外用的；外国的；外面的; n. 外部；外观；外面
example: External broadcasting soaks up more resources in Britain than elsewhere.
translation: 英国花费在对外广播上的财力高于其他国家。

meaning: v. 描绘；扮演
example: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
translation: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。

meaning: n. 神学院；学校；发源地；高级中学
n. [鱼] 鲦鱼（一种小淡水鱼）
example: Throw out a minnow to catch a whale.
translation: 弃小引大.

meaning: adj. 荒废的；即将过时的；逐渐被废弃的
example: Electronic equipment quickly becomes obsolescent.
translation: 电子设备淘汰得很快.

meaning: adj. 学术的；理论的；学院的; n. 大学生，大学教师；学者
example: Henry generally stayed ahead of the others in the academic subjects.
translation: 亨利的文化课成绩通常都优于其他学生。

meaning: v. 包含，吸收；体现；把……合并; adj. 合并的；一体化的；组成公司的
example: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities.
translation: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。

meaning: v. 参考；涉及；提到；查阅
example: He could refer the matter to the high court.
translation: 他可以将此事交由高等法院裁决。

meaning: n. 助动词；辅助者，辅助物；附属机构; adj. 辅助的；副的；附加的
example: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
translation: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

meaning: v. 指责，非难；制止；使相形见绌; n. 非难，指责；谴责，鞭策
example: "Silly little boy" was his favourite expression of rebuke to his pupils.
translation: “愚蠢的小家伙”是他最常用的斥责其学生的言辞。

meaning: v. 浓缩；凝结
example: We have learnt how to condense serious messages into short, self-contained sentences.
translation: 我们已经学会了如何把重要的信息压缩成简短独立的句子。

meaning: n. 扶壁；拱壁；支撑物; v. 支持；以扶壁支撑
example: He sought to buttress some of his arguments with quotations from Mein Kampf.
translation: 他引用《我的奋斗》中的语录来论证自己的观点。

meaning: n. 扩音器，麦克风
example: He wore a hidden microphone to secretly tape-record conversations.
translation: 他身上藏了一个传声器，打算偷偷录下谈话内容。

meaning: adj. 诉讼的；有异议的，引起争论的；爱争论的
example: Do avoid potentially contentious subjects such as religion, sex or politics.
translation: 一定要避免可能引起争议的话题，如宗教、性和政治。

meaning: v. 复制；使加倍; n. 副本；复制品; adj. 复制的；二重的
example: Charles scored again, with an exact duplicate of his first goal.
translation: 查尔斯梅开二度,与第一次破门如出一辙.

meaning: n. 大厦；宅邸
example: The price tag on the 34-room white Regency mansion is £17.5 million.
translation: 那栋有34个房间的摄政时期的白色官邸报价为1,750万英镑。

meaning: v. 使陶醉；使喝醉；使中毒
example: Wine has the power to intoxicate.
translation: 酒能醉人.

meaning: adj. 有深刻见解的，富有洞察力的
example: She offered some really interesting, insightful observations.
translation: 她给出了一些非常有趣又富有洞察力的评论。

meaning: n. 分子；计算者；计算器
example: One can show that the discriminant of the numerator is positive.
translation: 人们可以证明分子的判别式为正.

meaning: adj. 中立的，中性的；中立国的；非彩色的; n. 中立国；中立者；非彩色；齿轮的空档
example: "I know you," he said flatly, matter-of-fact, neutral in tone.
translation: “我认识你。”他平淡地说道，就事论事，不带任何感情。

meaning: adj. 可怕的；阴森的
example: gruesome pictures of dead bodies
translation: 恐怖的死人照片

meaning: n. 批准；承认，认可
example: The treaty is awaiting ratification.
translation: 条约正等待批准.

meaning: adj. 不同种类的，各式各样的; n. (Divers)人名；(英)戴弗斯；(法)迪韦尔
example: Coastguards had given up all hope of finding the two divers alive.
translation: 海岸警卫队对两位潜水员生还已完全不抱希望。

meaning: v. 转移；使…欢娱；使…转向; n. (Divert)人名；(法)迪韦尔
example: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.
translation: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。

meaning: adj. 过去的; n. 过去的事
example: The book recalls other memories of a bygone age.
translation: 这本书追忆了一个久远时代的别样记忆。

meaning: v. 奉承; n. 小鹿；浅黄褐色；小动物; adj. 浅黄褐色的
example: A small brown fawn hopped across the trail in front of them.
translation: 一只棕色的小鹿蹦跳着穿过他们面前的那条小路。

meaning: n. 恢复；重新开始；取回；重获；恢复硬币支付
example: It is premature to speculate about the resumption of negotiations.
translation: 现在猜测谈判是否会重新开始还为时过早。

meaning: v. 弄污；损害；诽谤
example: He has accused local people of trying to besmirch his reputation.
translation: 他指责当地人企图败坏他的名声。

meaning: adj. 复杂的；错综的，缠结的

translation: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

meaning: n. 剩余; adj. 剩余的

meaning: adj. 尖刻的（等于acerb）；酸的；辛辣的

meaning: n. 航空学；飞行术

meaning: adj. 简洁的，简明的

meaning: n. 最后通牒；最后结论；基本原理

meaning: adj. 懒洋洋的；无精打采的；伤感的

meaning: adj. 前面的；先前的

meaning: n. 滋事；骚乱；争论

meaning: v. 腐蚀，侵蚀

meaning: n. 一剂；一服；饮剂

meaning: v. 曲解，误解

translation: 从这样小的一份抽样出发容易得出曲解的结论.

meaning: n. 女低音；男声最高音；中音乐器; adj. 中音部的

translation: 唱歌的四个声部是女高音 、 女低音 、 男高音和男低音.

meaning: n. 小叶；传单

meaning: v. 提出（异议等）；使插入；使干涉

meaning: n. 风力计，[气象] 风速计

translation: 观察动态风速天气, 包括雷达, 国家海洋和大气局无线电广播.

meaning: adj. 慷慨的；丰厚的；宽宏的

meaning: n. 词汇；词表；词汇量

meaning: adj. 人口统计学的；人口学的

meaning: v. 宣布；装饰; n. 纹章；描绘

meaning: adj. 亲切的，友好的；和蔼的；适宜的

meaning: n. 托词；借口；诡计

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；表示特性的; n. 特征；特性；特色

translation: 一贯性急冲动的他又宣布要退学了。

meaning: v. 笨手笨脚地做；把…搞糟; n. 粗劣；失败；笨拙

meaning: v. 使狂喜；使著迷

meaning: adj. 卑鄙的；可怜的；不幸的；（境况）凄惨的，绝望的

translation: 他转过头看着这个噤若寒蝉的女孩，又重复了一遍他的问题。

meaning: n. 纠纷；意见不合；争吵；倾轧

translation: 空想社会主义；乌托邦社会主义

meaning: n. 晕头转向，[临床] 眩晕

meaning: n. 招聘；新兵；新成员; v. 补充；聘用；征募；使…恢复健康

translation: 各公司现在都急切地想要留住招聘来的员工。

meaning: v. 烤焦；使…枯萎; adj. 枯萎的；烤焦的; n. 烙印；烧焦痕迹

meaning: v. 困扰；镶嵌；围绕

meaning: n. 营，军营；军队，部队

meaning: adj. 惊人的；巨大的

meaning: n. 委员会；佣金；犯；委任；委任状; v. 委任；使服役；委托制作

meaning: prep. 除非；不包括；除…以外; v. 阻拦（bar的ing形式）; n. (Barring)人名；(德)巴林

meaning: adj. 浮躁的；易变的；变幻无常的

meaning: adj. 不光彩的；卑鄙的；卑贱的

meaning: adj. 静态的；静电的；静力的; n. 静电；静电干扰

meaning: n. 苦恼；恼怒；令人烦恼的事

meaning: adj. 无感觉的；无情的；无生命的

meaning: v. 妨碍；束缚；使困累; n. 食盒，食篮；阻碍物
example: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper.
translation: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。

meaning: n. [心理] 自恋，自我陶醉

meaning: adj. 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的

meaning: adj. 冷淡的；远离的；冷漠的; adv. 远离；避开地

meaning: v. 在之前；胜过；居前
v. 使扩大；使增大

translation: 可能会有更大的动荡，不过我想也不必夸大问题。

meaning: adj. 形象的；图表的；绘画似的

translation: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

meaning: v. 使移居国外；流放，放逐；使放弃国籍; n. 被流放者；移居国外者; adj. 移居国外的；被流放的

meaning: v. 使气馁，使畏缩；威吓; n. (Daunt)人名；(英)当特

meaning: v. 细分，再分

meaning: adj. 不变的；不可变的；不能变的

meaning: n. 基架，基座；基础; vt. 搁在台上；支持；加座

meaning: adj. 难吃的；令人讨厌的

meaning: adj. 熟练的，精通的; n. 精通；专家，能手

meaning: n. 执照，许可证；特许; v. 许可；特许；发许可证给

translation: 政府撤销了她丈夫管理外来打工人群的许可证。

meaning: adj. 交际的；爱说话的，健谈的；无隐讳交谈的

translation: 我们在语言教学中非常强调交际教学法。

meaning: n. 房东，老板；地主

meaning: n. 原告

meaning: n. 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由; v. 播种；结实；成熟；去…籽

meaning: v. 搪塞；支吾其辞，闪烁其辞

example: The new town would have been unrecognisable to the original inhabitants.

meaning: n. [数] 周期性；频率；定期性

translation: 原子核性质的周期性开始显示出来了.

meaning: v. 抑制；镇压；废止

translation: 某种有机的润湿剂或消泡剂十分有助于形成可过滤的半水物.

meaning: n. [机] 孔口

meaning: v. 使卷入；涉及；暗指；影响

example: Mr Alexander is not the slightest bit coy about his ambitions.

meaning: adj. 细心的；小心谨慎的；一丝不苟的
example: Each dress is hemmed and scrupulously checked for imperfections.
translation: 每条连衣裙都缝上了褶边，并经过严格的检查，不允许有任何瑕疵。

meaning: adj. 弹回的，有弹力的
example: George Fraser was clearly a good soldier, calm and resilient.
translation: 乔治·弗雷泽显然是个好士兵，沉着冷静且适应力强。

meaning: n. 振动；犹豫；心灵感应
example: However, heating energizes the vibrational, rotational, and electronic motions all at once.
translation: 但是, 加热会一下子把振动 、 转动和电子运动统统加强.

meaning: n. 复制品，复制物
example: An artist sculpted a full-size replica of her head.
translation: 一位艺术家按实际大小雕刻了一个她的头部模型。

meaning: adj. 偏僻的；弯曲的；不光明正大的
example: He was extremely devious in his efforts to achieve his heart's desire.
translation: 他在设法得到自己的中意之物时会不择手段。

meaning: adj. 粗腔横调的；发音不和谐的
example: They produced the most cacophonous beat of pop music.
translation: 他们制造了流行音乐最不协调的节拍。

meaning: adj. 无畏的；勇敢的；不屈不挠的
example: Dauntless in spirit, they became steeled through hardship.
translation: 他们不屈不挠, 在艰苦的生活中锻炼得更加坚强了.

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；精明的；节俭的; n. (Prudent)人名；(法)普吕当
example: Tone down your kamikaze tendencies and take more prudent risks.
translation: 别那么玩命，冒险时要谨慎些。

meaning: n. 圆筒；汽缸；[数] 柱面；圆柱状物
adj. 慈善的；善行的
example: The Silkworm Goddess had been beneficent to the tiny village this year.
translation: 今年蚕花娘娘保佑这小小的村子.

meaning: adj. 激烈的，猛烈的；热烈的
example: He has vehemently rejected claims that he is a government stooge.
translation: 他言辞激烈地驳斥了称自己是政府的狗奴才的说法。

meaning: n. 周期，期间；时期；月经；课时；（语法学）句点，句号; adj. 某一时代的
example: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: n. 抄写员；作家；划线器; v. 写下，记下；用划线器划
n. 论文；论点
example: graduation thesis
translation: 毕业论文；毕业设计

meaning: adj. 特别美味的；芬香的
example: The ambrosial and essential part of the fruit is lost with the bloom which is rubbed off in the market cart , and they become mere provender.
translation: 水果的美味和它那本质的部分，在装上了车子运往市场去的时候，跟它的鲜丽一起给磨损了，它变成了仅仅是食品。

meaning: n. 爱开玩笑的人；顽皮的人；恶作剧的人
example: The 70 - year - old shares traits of both utilitarian and prankster.
translation: 这位70 岁 的发明家集实用与搞怪于一身.

meaning: v. 听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告; n. 声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医] 探条; adj. 健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的; adv. 彻底地，充分地
n. [物] 波峰；冠；山顶；顶饰; v. 到达绝顶；形成浪峰
example: On the wall is the family crest.
translation: 墙上挂着那个家族的饰章。

meaning: n. 明喻；直喻
example: the similitude between humans and gorillas
translation: 人类和大猩猩的相像

meaning: n. [核] 中子
example: A neutron star has a gravitational field strong enough to generate X-rays.
translation: 中子星上存在强大的重力场，足以产生X射线。

meaning: n. 厌恶；憎恨；令人厌恶的事物
example: What is happening is an abomination.
translation: 正在发生的事令人非常反感。

meaning: v. 为…命名；为…施洗礼; n. (Christen)人名；(法、德、西、丹、挪)克里斯滕；(英)克里森
example: To christen the new hall, a number of great orchestras have been invited to play.
translation: 几个著名交响乐团受邀演出，以庆祝新音乐厅的启用。

meaning: adj. （要价等）过高的；（性格等）过分的；不在法律范围之内的
example: Investment remains tiny primarily because of the exorbitant cost of land.
translation: 投资仍然微乎其微，主要原因在于土地成本过高。

meaning: n. 面积，英亩数
example: About 70% of the cocoa acreage is treated with insecticide.
translation: 大约70%的可可树林地喷过杀虫剂。

meaning: n. 飓风，暴风
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: adj. 多毛的；[昆] 有粗毛的
translation: 男士也有他们的吹风机,而且如果他们秃顶的话, 还会用毛发生长剂 、 买假发, 或者把头发从密集的

meaning: adj. 极恶的；声名狼藉的；彻头彻尾的
example: That's arrant nonsense.
translation: 那完全是一派胡言。

meaning: n. [有化] 甘油；丙三醇
example: Nitroglycerin is obtained by nitrating glycerol.
translation: 硝化甘油是经过硝化丙三醇得来的.

meaning: n. 千里眼；异常的洞察力
example: Precognition is a form of clairvoyance.
translation: 预知是超人的洞察力的一种形式。

meaning: n. 心灵感应；传心术
v. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: v. 审查，检查；检查和删节; n. 检查员；[心理] 潜意识压抑力；信件检查员
example: Television companies tend to censor bad language in feature films.
translation: 电视公司往往会在审查故事片时删去其中的粗话。

meaning: n. 侧面；轮廓；外形；剖面；简况; v. 描…的轮廓；扼要描述
example: The police deliberately kept a low profile in most places.
translation: 警方在大多数地方有意保持低调。

meaning: n. [化工] 反应器；[核] 反应堆；起反应的人
example: They shut down the nuclear reactor for safety reasons.
translation: 出于安全原因他们关闭了核反应堆。

meaning: n. 痛悔；悔悟
example: The next day he'd be full of contrition, weeping and begging forgiveness.
translation: 第二天，他就会懊悔不已，哭着乞求原谅。

meaning: adj. 单边的；[植] 单侧的；单方面的；单边音；（父母）单系的
example: Finally, the author predicted the future trend of America's Unilateralism objectively.
translation: 最后, 客观地预测了美国单边主义的未来走向.

meaning: adj. 春天的；和煦的；青春的
example: Vernalization The cold treatment of ungerminated or partially germinated seeds.
translation: 春化作用:对于未发育或部分发育的种子进行冷处理的方法.

meaning: n. 冷凝；凝结；压缩；缩合聚合
example: Condensation will eventually cause the fabric of the building to rot away.
translation: 冷凝作用将最终使建筑结构腐朽掉。

meaning: adj. 年轻而无经验的；羽毛未丰的; n. (Callow)人名；(英)卡洛
example: He was a callow youth when he joined the newspaper.
translation: 他进报社时还是个乳臭未干的小子.

meaning: adj. 流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的
example: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.
translation: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。

meaning: n. 内阁；橱柜；展览艺术品的小陈列室; adj. 内阁的；私下的，秘密的
example: This issue, more than any other, has divided her cabinet.
translation: 主要是这一问题使她的内阁产生了分歧。

meaning: n. 批准；认可；赞成
example: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.
translation: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。

meaning: n. 副业；业余爱好；嗜好
example: Make authorship your avocation, not your vocation.
translation: 把写作当作你的副业, 不要把它当作正业.

meaning: n. 岁差（等于precession of the equinoxes）；先行；优先
example: He then accounts for the precession of the equinoxes.
translation: 然后他解释分点岁差.

meaning: n. 巧合；一致；同时发生
example: Does coincidence come under the umbrella of the paranormal?
translation: 巧合属于超自然现象吗？

meaning: adj. 树木的；栖息在树上的
example: Man was evolved from an ancestor that was probably arboreal.
translation: 人大概是从住在树上的祖先进化而来的.

meaning: v. 开发，开拓；剥削；开采; n. 勋绩；功绩
example: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

meaning: n. 单位，单元；装置；[军] 部队；部件
example: Russia demanded that Unita send a delegation to the peace talks.
translation: 俄罗斯要求安盟派代表团参加和谈。

meaning: n. 灾难；不幸遭遇
example: A verdict of death by misadventure was recorded.
translation: 判定为意外死亡。

meaning: n. 国籍，国家；民族；部落
example: Discrimination by employers on the grounds of race and nationality was illegal.
translation: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

meaning: adj. 告别的; n. 告别辞
example: Hydrogen is a one - valence element.
translation: 氢是一价的元素.

meaning: n. 使用；用法；惯例
example: In the 1980 s USAID was still providing assistance in varying amounts to 56 nations.
translation: 直到80年代,美国国际开发署还在为56个国家提供数额不等的援助.

meaning: n. 清洁
example: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
translation: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

meaning: n. 蛛丝；薄纱；小蜘蛛网; adj. 轻飘飘的；薄弱的
example: a gown of gossamer silk
translation: 丝绸女裙服

meaning: n. 炼狱；涤罪；暂时的苦难; adj. 涤罪的（等于purgative）
example: Prayers were said for souls in Purgatory.
translation: 祷告词是为炼狱中的灵魂念的。

meaning: adj. 凶恶的；重罪的；极恶的
example: He carried out a felonious act.
translation: 他犯了一个重罪.

meaning: n. 情节剧；音乐剧；耸人听闻的事件，闹剧
example: The video was seven minutes of high camp and melodrama.
translation: 那段录像里是7分钟极尽夸张搞笑的闹剧表演。

meaning: n. [数] 梯形；[数] 不规则四边形; adj. 梯形的；[数] 不规则四边形的
n. 赤字；不足额
example: These will be very constrained budgets designed to get the deficit down.
translation: 这些预算旨在减少赤字，将会大大受限。

meaning: adj. 不同的
example: It would be difficult to find two men who were more dissimilar.
translation: 很难找到彼此间差异更大的人了。

meaning: n. 佣金；回扣；中间人业务
example: John works for a brokerage house now.
translation: 约翰现在一家经纪行工作.

meaning: n. 破裂，断裂；[外科] 骨折; v. 破裂；折断
example: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
translation: 他右手食指骨裂。

meaning: adj. 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的; n. (Modest)人名；(罗)莫代斯特；(德)莫德斯特；(俄)莫杰斯特
example: Though his background was modest, it was in no sense deprived.
translation: 尽管他家境一般，但也并不贫穷。

meaning: v. 蒸发
example: Customer installations generally include a tank, vaporizer, and pressure control manifold.
translation: 用户使用的设备一般包括储存罐 、 汽化器和压力控制管.

meaning: adj. 冗长的；说话啰嗦的
example: Too much speaking makes it a little prolix .
translation: 说了那么多，有些罗嗦了。

meaning: n. [光] 分光镜
example: Spectroscopic emulsion should be stored in a dry, oxygen - free environment.
translation: 光谱测量用的乳胶应贮存在干燥 、 无氧的环境中.

meaning: n. 演说家；雄辩家；朗诵者
adj. 爱开玩笑的；打趣的；滑稽的
example: He was in a less jocular mood than usual.
translation: 他不像往常一样那么爱开玩笑。

meaning: n. 焦点；中心；清晰；焦距; v. 使集中；使聚焦
example: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
translation: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

meaning: adj. 不用的；从未用过的
n. 订婚；婚约
example: Their betrothal took place with great pomp and rejoicings.
translation: 他们举行了盛大而又欢乐的订婚仪式.

meaning: n. 挫折；退步；逆流
n. [药] 兴奋剂；刺激物；酒精饮料; adj. 激励的；使人兴奋的
example: Stimulate the site of greatest pain with a small negative current.
translation: 以微弱负电流刺激疼得最厉害的部位。

meaning: v. 减少；变小
example: Yet, as earth's other natural resources dwindle, nations eye the Antarctic as a final repository.
translation: 然而, 由于地球上其他自然资源的减少, 一些国家视南极洲为最后的宝库.

meaning: adj. 贪婪的；贪吃的；渴望的
example: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
translation: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

meaning: adj. 细长的；苗条的；微薄的
example: slender body
translation: 细长体；瘦长体

meaning: n. 流浪的人；被驱逐的人; adj. 被遗弃的；无家可归的；被逐出的
example: He had always been an outcast, unwanted and alone.
translation: 他一直都被视为异类，无人理睬，形单影只。

meaning: v. 缩减；剪短；剥夺…特权等
example: I told Louie that old age would curtail her activities in time.
translation: 我告诉路易，一上年纪她的活动量就会减少。

meaning: adj. 合逻辑的，合理的；逻辑学的
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: v. 交易；谈判
adj. 有责任的：顺从的，服从的；有义务的；经得起检验的
example: The Jordanian leader seemed amenable to attending a conference.
translation: 约旦领导人似乎愿意参加会议。

meaning: v. 利用
example: My limited diplomatic skills were tested to the utmost.
translation: 我有限的外交手腕儿受到了极其严峻的考验。

meaning: v. 引出；演绎；使显出
example: The teacher was unable to educe an answer from her pupils.
translation: 老师无法从学生口中得到任何答案.

meaning: v. 讨厌，厌恶
example: I loathe negativity. I can't stand people who moan.
translation: 我厌恶消极态度，不能忍受唉声叹气的人。

meaning: v. 煽动；挑起；热敷
example: The rebels know the truth and seek to foment revolution.
translation: 那些叛乱者知道真相,并且想办法来挑起革命.

meaning: adj. 明智的；头脑精明的；判断正确的
example: We should listen to the judicious opinion of that old man.
translation: 我们应该听取那位老人明智的意见.

meaning: adj. 简单的；坦率的；明确的；径直的; adv. 直截了当地；坦率地
example: The policy of the annually balanced budget represents a rigid straightjacket.
translation: 年度平衡预算的政策是一种刻板的束缚.

meaning: n. 无政府状态；混乱；无秩序
example: He had been swept aside in the whirlwind of reform and anarchy.
translation: 在改革和无政府状态交织的混乱风暴中，他被抛在了一边，没人理睬。

meaning: n. 极化；偏振；两极分化
example: There is increasing polarization between the blacks and whites in the US.
translation: 美国黑人和白人之间的分化在加剧。

meaning: v. 解放；释放
example: This new machine will emancipate us from the hard work.
translation: 这部新机器将把我们从繁重劳动中解放出来.

meaning: n. 漏斗；烟囱; v. 通过漏斗或烟囱等；使成漏斗形
example: He poured the petrol into the car through a funnel.
translation: 他用一个漏斗把汽油灌入汽车.

meaning: adj. 异端的；邪道的；极恶的; n. 异端；恶棍；罪大恶极之人
example: How easy it has been in this febrile atmosphere to point the finger at miscreant journalists.
translation: 在目前这股热潮中,对那些不道德的记者指指戳戳是多么的容易.

meaning: n. 出身；亲子关系；门第；起源
example: She's a Londoner of mixed parentage (English and Jamaican).
translation: 她是个混血（英国和牙买加）伦敦人。

meaning: adj. 迟钝的，迟缓的；不活泼的；麻痹的；[生物] 蛰伏的
example: Nothing could dispel the torpidity of the indifferent audience.
translation: 任何东西都无法驱散那些冷漠观众的困倦.

meaning: v. 镀锌；通电；刺激
example: Still , the major countries have been unable to galvanize themselves into action.
translation: 他们很少或没有与非国家行为者的联系.

meaning: adj. （疾病等）（全国、全球i）流行的；普遍的; n. 流行性疾病
example: One pandemic of Spanish flu took nearly 22 million lives worldwide.
translation: 西班牙流感的大爆发夺去了全球近2,200万人的生命。

meaning: n. [语] 反义词
example: "Long" is the antonym of "short".
translation: “长”是“短”的反义词。

meaning: n. 爱好；由衷的高兴；嗜好
example: Hers was a minor part, but she played it with gusto.
translation: 她演的是个小角色，但是演得很投入。

meaning: n. 狂热者；犹太教狂热信徒
example: Their support bordered on zealotry.
translation: 他们的支持已近乎狂热。

meaning: adj. 终身的
example: I've had a lifelong fascination with the sea and with small boats.
translation: 我一生都对大海和小船着迷。

meaning: v. 喋喋而言；胡扯; n. 三棱石；无法听懂的话
n. 皱纹；犁沟；车辙; v. 犁；耕；弄绉
example: The government is more than adept at ploughing its own diplomatic furrow.
translation: 政府在制定自己独树一帜的外交政策时无比娴熟。

meaning: n. 镜子；真实的写照；榜样; v. 反射；反映
example: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
translation: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

meaning: adj. 讽刺的；嘲笑的，冷笑的
adj. 贪婪的；渴望的；狼吞虎咽的
example: What's for lunch? I'm absolutely ravenous.
translation: 午饭吃什么？我饿死了。

meaning: adj. 冷酷的；不知过错的；坚持不懈的；不屈不挠的
example: the remorseless increase in crime
translation: 犯罪的持续增长

meaning: n. [植] 叶绿体
example: A brief review of chloroplast structure is useful before discussing these experiments.
translation: 在讨论这些试验以前,对叶绿体结构作一简短的概述是有益的.

meaning: n. 障碍；错误; v. 阻止；推诿；错过
example: To emancipate all mankind, we will balk at no sacrifice . even that of our lives.
translation: 为了全人类的解放, 即使牺牲生命也在所不惜.

meaning: v. 渗透；穿透；洞察
example: They are hoping to penetrate the Japanese market with their latest product.
translation: 他们希望他们的最新产品能打进日本市场.

meaning: n. 电脑高速缓冲存储器；贮存物；隐藏处; v. 隐藏；窖藏
example: A huge arms cache was discovered by police.
translation: 警方发现了大批私藏的军火。

meaning: n. 包；捆；灾祸；不幸; v. 将打包
example: a bale of hay
translation: 一大捆干草

meaning: n. 多变；轻浮；轻率；不稳定

translation: 在纽约，警报声是无处不在的背景噪音。

meaning: n. 镍；镍币；五分镍币; v. 镀镍于

translation: 镍可做成钱币.

meaning: adj. 乏味的；温和的；冷漠的; vt. 使…变得淡而无味；除掉…的特性; vi. 变得平淡无奇；丧失特性; n. (Bland)人名；(英)布兰德

translation: 摘要机器人在实际应用时, 很多时候要求其具备弹跳装置以便跃过障碍物或沟渠.

meaning: adj. 易怒的；倔强的，难以对待的

translation: 孩子们肯定会耍脾气。

meaning: n. [有化] 碳水化合物；[有化] 糖类

translation: 运动员通常吃高碳水化合物食物.

meaning: adj. 致命的，致死的; n. 致死因子

translation: 这些障碍物对于想要往上游游动的鱼儿来说是致命的。

meaning: n. [雷达] 雷达，无线电探测器
adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的; n. 远程

translation: 从统计数据来看，我们成为暴力犯罪受害者的可能性微乎其微。

meaning: n. 弦；和弦；香水的基调

translation: 伯克的观点无疑引起了议会的积极回应。

meaning: v. 爆炸，爆发；激增

translation: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

meaning: n. 老生常谈；司空见惯的事；普通的东西; adj. 平凡的；陈腐的

translation: 在街上看见有人饿晕是很平常的事。

meaning: adj. 同步的；同时的

translation: 两数可以同步地向相反方向移位.

meaning: v. 欺骗；行骗
example: The boys, if my eyes did not deceive me, were praying.
translation: 如果我没有看错的话，那些男孩子正在祈祷。

meaning: n. [药] 抗生素；抗生学

meaning: adj. 教区的；狭小的；地方范围的

meaning: n. 地位；状态；情形；重要身份

meaning: n. 预兆，征兆；先驱；传令官；报信者; v. 通报；预示…的来临

translation: 他们的发现可能预示着为某些类型的阳痿找到了医治方法。

meaning: n. 文学；文献；文艺；著作

translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 限制；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限；缺陷

translation: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

meaning: n. 传记；档案；个人简介

translation: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

meaning: adj. 昏迷的；无知觉的；麻木不仁的

translation: 他们对这些危险并非没有意识。

meaning: adj. 能忍耐的；可忍受的；能持久的

meaning: adj. 预备的; n. 预科；预备学校

translation: 她把烤箱加热，准备把馅饼放进去。

translation: 结论尿GH水平测定无创、简便,配合IGF1等指标的检测,对于矮小儿童的诊断和鉴别诊断具有重要意义.

meaning: adj. 贫瘠的；不生育的；无益的；沉闷无趣的；空洞的; n. 荒地

translation: 他祈祷自己不孕的妻子有朝一日能怀上宝宝。

meaning: adj. 短暂的，暂时的；瞬息的

translation: 我预感他会给我带来危险。

meaning: adj. 蓬乱的，不整洁的；（言语等）粗野的

meaning: v. 把……装入桶内; n. 桶；枪管，炮管

translation: 他们在一只生锈的油桶里烧木柴来保暖。

meaning: n. 输出，输出量；产量；出产; v. 输出

translation: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

meaning: 世界形成前的

translation: 传记必须在一定程度上描绘人物。

translation: 他崇高的思想和彬彬有礼的举止令人赞美.

meaning: n. 反气旋，反旋风；高气压

translation: 反气旋天气情况比气旋天气情况更有利些.

meaning: n. 压力计；[流] 测压计；血压计

translation: 最简单的压力计,是开管流体压力计.

meaning: v. 使转变；转换…；使…改变信仰; n. 皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

translation: 我们想把阁楼改造成又一间卧室。

meaning: n. 少量，一点点

meaning: v. 行宣福礼；使享福

translation: 5月，教皇约翰·保罗将为吉安娜·贝雷塔行宣福礼。

meaning: adj. 缺乏的；全无的

meaning: n. 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事

translation: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

translation: 在您的左边, 您看到的是暴龙, 一种来自侏罗纪的肉食动物.

meaning: adj. 透明的；清晰的；明了的

meaning: adj. 横向的；横断的；贯轴的; n. 横断面；贯轴；横肌

meaning: n. 压力；压迫，[物] 压强; v. 迫使；密封；使……增压

meaning: adj. 明显的；可感知的；易觉察的

meaning: n. 亲属；家属

translation: 不管制订的是什么样的养生计划，都要严格遵守。

meaning: n. 犹豫

translation: 米雷拉走近他，犹豫片刻后，和他握了握手。

translation: 他们今天必须驱逐一些吉普赛人，我得去把那个区域圈起来。

meaning: adj. 惩罚性的；刑罚的

translation: 有人呼吁对酒后驾车的人要有更具处罚性的措施。

translation: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。

meaning: n. 胜利，凯旋；欢欣; v. 获得胜利，成功

translation: 他以胜利者的姿态进入墨西哥城。

meaning: adj. 遗忘的；健忘的；不注意的；不知道的

translation: 卢埃林看起来没有注意到他周围的情况。

meaning: adj. 主要的；资本的; n. 首长；校长；资本；当事人

translation: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

meaning: n. 蜘蛛；设圈套者；三脚架

translation: 中美洲的一种兰花,具有蜘蛛状花朵,花上长有突出的绿色的瘤.

meaning: n. [医] 震颤；颤动

meaning: n. [电] 导管；沟渠；导水管

meaning: n. 火葬用的柴堆

translation: 用于焚尸的汽油越来越成为一个难以解决的问题.

meaning: n. 口是心非；表里不一；不诚实

translation: 马尔科姆认为他在为其私底下两面派的行为而心生愧疚。

meaning: n. 大火；快速燃烧；突发；冲突

translation: 1947年的一场大火,使90%的房屋化为灰烬.

meaning: n. 恳求者，乞求者

example: They were finally forced to capitulate to the terrorists' demands.
translation: 他们最后被迫屈从恐怖分子的要求。

meaning: adj. 暴虐的，暴君的；专横的

translation: 该国处在一个专制暴君的统治之下。

meaning: v. 抵挡；禁得起；反抗

translation: 他做《纽约先驱报》的当地特约记者来赚些外快。

meaning: n. 喜欢；庆祝；欢呼
example: His resignation was greeted by jubilation on the streets of Sofia.
translation: 他辞职下台了，索菲亚大街小巷一片欢腾。

meaning: n. 比率，比例

translation: 1978年有884名学生，师生比为1比15。

meaning: v. 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事; adj. 空闲的，有闲的
example: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him.
translation: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

meaning: v. 责骂；训斥

translation: 他妻子开始指责他不照顾孩子。

meaning: n. 附加物；下属；[动][解剖] 附器（如植物的枝叶和动物的腿尾）

translation: 麦克米伦肯定极不喜欢只被当成国内政治的附属品。

translation: 我向凯特提起这个想法，她不反对。

meaning: n. 参议员；（古罗马的）元老院议员；评议员，理事

translation: 他在参议院期间有过国防和外交政策方面的经验。

meaning: v. 使迎合；使讨好；使逢迎

translation: 他的计划的第一步是拉拢委员会的成员。

translation: 他犯了一个错误，他的事业就很不体面地结束了。

meaning: n. 中途；娱乐场; adj. 中途的; adv. 中途

translation: 工作室就在从他姑姑的老宅到他的小屋的中途。

meaning: n. 富裕；丰富；流入；汇聚

translation: 少数富裕地区与贫困地区并存。

meaning: n. [水利] 渡槽；导水管；沟渠

meaning: adj. 平板状的；有平面的; v. 使成平面；把…制成表格

translation: 二元函数的列表法是不方便的, 然而是可能的.

meaning: n. 刺绣，缝纫；女红的作品

meaning: adj. 兄弟般的；友好的

translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

translation: 她不择手段地利用自己的魅力让男人们做她想要做的事情.

meaning: v. 领先，在…之前；优于，高于

translation: 他给艾丽斯做手势，让她在他们前面离开房间。

meaning: adj. 不愉快的；厌恶的；不为人喜的；难相处的；脾气坏的

meaning: v. 恳求，哀求；恳请

meaning: n. 平衡；余额；匀称; v. 使平衡；结算；使相称

meaning: n. 会计师；会计人员

meaning: adj. 白话的；通俗的；口语体的

meaning: v. 刺穿；钉住；使绝望

meaning: adj. 隐居的；隐遁的

meaning: v. 惋惜；为…恸哭

meaning: n. [数] 乘法；增加

translation: 他来到纳塔尔亲自了解最近发生的激烈冲突造成的后果。

meaning: v. 使改方向；重新寄送; adj. 再直接的; n. 再直接询问

translation: 她也皈依了天主教。

meaning: adj. 辩护的；为自己辩护的; n. 被告

translation: 他声称被告是被诱骗的，从而推翻了有罪的判决。

meaning: v. 放弃；舍弃；禁忌

translation: 如果爱与友情不能并存，那我定会放弃一份无结果的爱。

meaning: adj. 奸诈的，叛逆的，背叛的；危险的；不牢靠的

meaning: n. 平行线；对比; v. 使…与…平行; adj. 平行的；类似的，相同的

translation: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

translation: 1945至1946年的那段时间是杜鲁门总统执政最艰难的时期。

translation: 我们遗憾地通知您，您将要无限期地在家待岗。

translation: 那个老守财奴找到一个新的替罪羊,这样我就脱身了.

meaning: v. 授予，赋予；穿上

translation: 他日夜祈求上帝赋予他虔敬的心.

meaning: adj. 数值的；数字的；用数字表示的（等于numeric）

meaning: adj. 嗅觉的；味道的; n. 嗅觉器官

meaning: adj. 第一百的；一百分之一的; n. 第一百，第一百个；百分之一

meaning: adj. 有趣的；迷人的; v. 引起…的兴趣；策划阴谋；私通（intrigue的ing形式）

meaning: adj. 有两足的; n. 两足动物

meaning: v. 代替；排挤掉

meaning: adj. 顽强的；坚韧的；固执的；紧握的；黏着力强的

translation: 事业要成功，才能、勤奋和顽强的意志都至关重要。

meaning: n. 激光

meaning: adj. 冒泡的，沸腾的；兴奋的

translation: 美国是学术、艺术和政治氛围最活跃的国家。

meaning: v. 平息；缓和；减轻

example: The prose of his official communications was so laboured, pompous and verbose.
translation: 他笔下的公文矫揉浮华，长篇大论。

meaning: n. [数] 定理；原理

meaning: n. 衣庄；呢绒商

meaning: n. 动力；促进；冲力

translation: 用已污染的手将小儿的头部转向右侧以吸引左侧支气管.

meaning: v. 增殖；扩散；激增

meaning: v. 免除；赦免；宣告…无罪

translation: 鉴于你不可救药的无知,我原谅你.

translation: 在你打发我们走以前再请仔细考虑一下吧.

meaning: v. 废弃；使…过时；使…具有古旧形式或风格; adj. 过时的；旧式的
example: This latest device will antiquate the ice - cube tray.

meaning: n. 系列，连续；[电] 串联；级数；丛书
